title.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段裡的 `claude -p` 不再誤報沒登入
title.en: `claude -p` in cloud sessions no longer falsely reports "Not logged in"

body.zh-TW: 明明登入好了，腳本卻回你「Not logged in」，很容易讓人摸不著頭緒。這發生在雲端工作階段裡另外執行 `claude -p`（不開互動畫面、直接回一次答案）時：只要沒帶上該工作階段的環境變數，就會這樣誤報。現在不會了。
body.en: Running `claude -p` (which answers once without opening the interactive screen) inside a cloud session without that session's environment variables used to report "Not logged in", as if you had never signed in. It no longer does.

items.original: Fixed `claude -p` inside cloud sessions reporting "Not logged in" when started without the session's environment variables

title.zh-TW: 接很多 MCP 工具時，API 錯誤不再被誤報成對話太長
title.en: With many MCP tools, API errors are no longer mislabeled as "prompt is too long"

body.zh-TW: 明明才聊幾句，畫面卻說「prompt is too long」，你可能以為得開新對話了。這發生在接了很多 MCP 工具（讓 Claude 連外部服務的擴充）的工作階段：碰到 API 錯誤時，錯誤訊息會被換成這句。它還會順手做一次不必要的 compaction（把舊對話濃縮成摘要）。現在你看到的是原本的 API 錯誤，對話也不會白白被壓縮。
body.en: In sessions with many MCP tools (extensions that connect Claude to outside services), an API error used to show up as "prompt is too long", making you think the conversation had grown too long. It also triggered an unneeded compaction (condensing older conversation into a summary). Now you see the original API error, and your conversation is not compacted for nothing.

items.original: Fixed an API error being replaced by "prompt is too long", and an unneeded compaction, in sessions with many MCP tools

title.zh-TW: 新增 `sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces`，Linux 沙盒裡也能跑 Chromium
title.en: New `sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces` lets Chromium run inside the Linux sandbox

body.zh-TW: 在 Linux 上請 Claude 開 Chromium 跑網頁測試，或用 rootless podman 開容器，指令常在 sandbox（把指令關在隔離區執行的保護）裡卡住。這兩種程式都得自己建立 user namespace（Linux 讓程式擁有一套獨立身分的機制）。現在可以在 settings.json 加上 `{"sandbox": {"allowNestedUserNamespaces": true}}` 放行。⟦把隔離病房的鑰匙也交給病人，以前門鎖死、該做的檢查做不了，現在檢查做得了，但病人也能自己開門走出去。⟧官方寫得很明白：打開後，這些指令能繞過沙盒的檔案保護，所以確定需要再開。
body.en: On Linux, asking Claude to launch Chromium for web tests or start containers with rootless podman often got stuck inside the sandbox (the protection that runs commands in an isolated area). Both programs need to create their own user namespaces (a Linux feature that gives a program its own separate identity). You can now allow it by adding `{"sandbox": {"allowNestedUserNamespaces": true}}` to settings.json. ⟦Handing the patient the key to the isolation ward means the tests that were blocked behind a locked door can finally run, but the patient can also walk out on their own.⟧ The changelog is explicit: once on, these commands can get around the sandbox's file protections, so turn it on only when you need it.

items.original: Added `sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces` so sandboxed commands on Linux can create user namespaces (Chromium, rootless podman); this lets them get around the sandbox's file protections

title.zh-TW: 新增 `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_USAGE_LIMIT_RECHECK_MS`，用量上限提早解除也接得上
title.en: New `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_USAGE_LIMIT_RECHECK_MS` catches usage limits lifted early

body.zh-TW: 睡前開著無人看管的重試模式 `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`，讓 Claude 通宵跑長任務，半夜撞到用量上限，它就一路等到重置時間才繼續。可是上限有時在重置前就解除了，它卻不會發現，白白多等好幾個小時。新的環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_USAGE_LIMIT_RECHECK_MS` 讓它在等待期間重新檢查上限，名稱結尾的 MS 代表單位是毫秒。用法是啟動前在終端機打 `export CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_USAGE_LIMIT_RECHECK_MS=600000`，600000 毫秒就是 10 分鐘。⟦排餐廳候位時，以前只能等店員預告的時間才回來，現在每隔一陣子探頭問一次，一有空位就入座。⟧
body.en: Before bed you turn on unattended retry mode, `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`, so Claude can grind through a long task overnight; when it hits a usage limit, it waits all the way to the reset time. But limits are sometimes lifted before the reset, and it never noticed, wasting hours. The new environment variable `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_USAGE_LIMIT_RECHECK_MS` makes it recheck the limit while waiting; the MS at the end means the unit is milliseconds. Set it in the terminal before starting with `export CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_USAGE_LIMIT_RECHECK_MS=600000`, where 600000 milliseconds is 10 minutes. ⟦Waiting for a restaurant table, you used to come back only at the time the host quoted; now you poke your head in every so often and sit down as soon as a table frees up.⟧

items.original: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_USAGE_LIMIT_RECHECK_MS` so unattended retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) notices a usage limit that was lifted before its reset

title.zh-TW: 工具搜尋被端點或閘道拒絕時，請求不再全部失敗
title.en: Requests no longer all fail when an endpoint or gateway rejects tool search

body.zh-TW: 升到 2.1.304 之後，透過雲端供應商或公司閘道（轉送 AI 請求的中間站）用 Claude Code 的人，可能每問一句都直接失敗。Vertex、Bedrock 等供應商的端點或閘道會拒絕 tool search（讓 Claude 需要時才搜尋載入工具的功能）；閘道禁用 ToolSearch，或 `--tools` 沒列它時也一樣。這是 2.1.304 帶進來的退步，現在 Claude Code 遇到這種情況，會拿掉它再重試。
body.en: After upgrading to 2.1.304, anyone using Claude Code through a cloud provider or a company gateway (a relay that forwards AI requests) may have seen every single request fail. The endpoints of providers such as Vertex and Bedrock, or a gateway, rejected tool search (the feature that lets Claude look up and load tools only when needed); the same happened behind gateways that disallowed ToolSearch or left it out of `--tools`. This was a 2.1.304 regression, and Claude Code now retries without it.

items.original: Fixed every request failing on Vertex, Bedrock and other providers when the endpoint or a gateway rejects tool search, and behind gateways with ToolSearch disallowed or left out of `--tools` (a 2.1.304 regression): Claude Code now retries without it

title.zh-TW: `/usage` 的警告附上一行修法，按 `f` 直接套用
title.en: `/usage` warnings come with one-line fixes you apply with `f`

body.zh-TW: 打 `/usage` 看用量時，底下常冒出幾條警告，以前你得自己查是哪個設定造成、又該怎麼改。現在每條警告都濃縮成一行修法，並寫明來自哪裡；看完按 `f`，這些修法就會直接套用。⟦汽車儀表板以前只亮一顆看不懂的燈，現在燈旁直接寫「左前輪胎壓偏低，按這裡預約補氣」。⟧同樣的修法也會出現在 VS Code 和 `/doctor` 裡，在哪邊看到就在哪邊修，不必記住要回哪個畫面處理。
body.en: When you type `/usage` to check your usage, a few warnings often show up underneath, and you used to have to work out which setting caused each one and how to fix it. Now each warning is a one-line fix that names its source; press `f` and the fixes are applied. ⟦A dashboard that used to light up one cryptic lamp now prints "front-left tire low, tap here to book air" right beside it.⟧ The same fixes also appear in VS Code and `/doctor`, so you can fix them wherever you spot them.

items.original: Improved `/usage`: each warning is now a one-line fix that names its source, and `f` applies the fixes; the same fixes appear in VS Code and `/doctor`

title.zh-TW: `allowedMcpServers` 不再篩部分受管 MCP 伺服器，Desktop 掛載外掛也收緊權限
title.en: `allowedMcpServers` stops filtering some managed MCP servers, and Desktop-mounted plugins lose their tool grants

body.zh-TW: 公司 IT 用受管設定（組織統一下發、員工改不了的設定）管 Claude Code 的話，有兩處行為改了。`managed-mcp.json` 裡的 stdio MCP 伺服器若只在 `env` 用到 `${VAR}`，`allowedMcpServers` 白名單不再篩它，所以名單沒列到的這類伺服器，升級後會開始載入。想繼續擋，就寫進 `deniedMcpServers`。另一處是 Claude Desktop 以路徑掛載的外掛：組織設了 `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly` 時，外掛自帶的 `allowed-tools` 不再保留。⟦大樓門禁換了規則，白名單沒寫到的某類訪客以前擋在門外，現在直接放行，要擋得另外列黑名單；外包廠商自帶的通行證，在大樓只認管理處證件時也不再算數。⟧
body.en: If your company's IT manages Claude Code through managed settings (rules pushed by the organization that employees cannot change), two behaviors change. In `managed-mcp.json`, stdio MCP servers that use `${VAR}` only in `env` are no longer filtered by the `allowedMcpServers` allowlist, so one your allowlist left out now loads after upgrading. To keep it off, add it to `deniedMcpServers`. The other change covers plugins Claude Desktop mounts by path: when your organization sets `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`, they no longer keep their own `allowed-tools`. ⟦A building changed its access rules: one kind of visitor missing from the guest list used to be turned away and now walks right in unless put on a blocklist, while a contractor's own pass stops counting once the building accepts only badges from the management office.⟧

items.original:
Changed `allowedMcpServers` to stop filtering `managed-mcp.json` stdio servers that use `${VAR}` only in `env`: one your allowlist left out now loads on upgrade; use `deniedMcpServers` to keep it off
Changed plugins that Claude Desktop mounts by path to no longer keep their `allowed-tools` when your organization's managed settings set `allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly`

title.zh-TW: `/effort` 對大小寫不同的模型名也生效，磁碟滿的錯誤改講白話
title.en: `/effort` applies despite model-name case differences, and full-disk errors speak plainly

body.zh-TW: 在終端機裡最常撞到的幾個小毛病，這版一次修掉。模型名跟 `modelOverrides` 裡的值只差大小寫，或多一個 `[1m]` 標記時，`/effort` 和 `/autocompact` 的設定以前不會套用，現在會。磁碟滿了還叫 Claude 跑 Bash 指令，以前只丟出一串帶 `ENOSPC` 的檔案路徑，現在直接說磁碟已滿、指令沒有執行。終端機視窗窄的時候，`/usage` 的列不再被切掉。啟動警告以前會以原始文字印在標誌上方，現在改寫進除錯紀錄；完全沒限制任何東西的權限規則，會在橫幅下方以警告列顯示。
body.en: This release clears out several small annoyances you hit right in the terminal. When a model name differed from a `modelOverrides` value only by letter case or a `[1m]` tag, `/effort` and `/autocompact` settings did not apply; now they do. Running a Bash command on a full disk used to fail with nothing but a raw `ENOSPC` file path; the error now says the disk is full and that nothing ran. In narrow terminals, `/usage` rows are no longer cut off. Startup warnings used to print as raw text above the logo; they now go to the debug log, and permission rules that restrict nothing show as warning rows under the banner.

items.original:
Fixed `/effort` and `/autocompact` settings not applying when the model name differed from a `modelOverrides` value by letter case or a `[1m]` tag
Fixed Bash commands on a full disk failing with a raw `ENOSPC` file path: the error now says the disk is full and that nothing ran
Fixed `/usage` rows being cut off in narrow terminals
Fixed startup warnings printing as raw text above the logo: they now go to the debug log, and permission rules that restrict nothing show as warning rows under the banner

title.zh-TW: 螢幕閱讀器不再把搜尋框念成電話錄音機，`/artifacts` 刪除改用數字確認
title.en: Screen readers stop calling the search box a telephone recorder, and `/artifacts` delete uses number keys

body.zh-TW: 用螢幕閱讀器（把畫面文字念出來的輔助軟體）的人，以前會聽到一些莫名其妙的念法。搜尋框原本顯示一個符號，VoiceOver 會念成「telephone recorder」，現在改顯示「Search:」。被標亮的提示文字，例如 Ctrl+R 搜尋的符合處和「ultrathink」，字中間也不再冒出空格。MCP 的同意對話框也調整了，你本來要用來送出提示的 Enter，比較不會被誤當成按下 Accept。`/artifacts` 的刪除確認改成按 1 或 Enter 保留、按 2 刪除、按 Esc 取消，`y` 和 `n` 不再能回答它。
body.en: If you use a screen reader (assistive software that reads the screen aloud), you may have heard some baffling announcements. Search boxes used to show a symbol that VoiceOver read as "telephone recorder"; they now say "Search:". Highlighted prompt text, such as Ctrl+R search matches and "ultrathink", no longer has spaces inside words. MCP consent dialogs were adjusted too, so an Enter meant to send your prompt is less likely to be taken as Accept. The `/artifacts` delete confirmation now takes 1 or Enter to keep, 2 to delete and Esc to cancel; `y` and `n` no longer answer it.

items.original:
Fixed screen reader mode: search boxes now say "Search:" instead of a symbol VoiceOver read as "telephone recorder", and highlighted prompt text, such as Ctrl+R search matches and "ultrathink", no longer has spaces inside words
Improved MCP consent dialogs so an Enter meant for the prompt is less likely to be taken as Accept
Changed the `/artifacts` delete confirmation to take 1 or Enter to keep, 2 to delete, and Esc to cancel; `y` and `n` no longer answer it

title.zh-TW: 子代理換備援模型後，Claude 不再報錯模型名
title.en: Claude names the right model after a subagent switches to a fallback

body.zh-TW: 讓 Claude 分派子代理（替主對話分頭做事的小幫手）的人，可能遇過下面幾種怪事。子代理切換到備援模型後，Claude 以前會講錯是哪個模型做的，現在會講對。在 bare repository（只有版本紀錄、沒有工作檔案的 Git 倉庫）開新 worktree，以前有時從本機 HEAD 起頭，而不是預設分支；沒改過東西的子代理 worktree 有時也沒被清掉。排程的 Cowork 雲端工作階段裡，子代理用 WebFetch 碰到要核准的網址卻沒人在場，以前每個都乾等五分鐘，這版修掉更多這類情況。Workflow 續跑時，已完成的 `pipeline()` 和 `parallel()` 代理不再重跑，改從執行紀錄取結果。
body.en: If you have Claude hand work to subagents (helpers that split off tasks from the main conversation), you may have seen a few oddities. After a subagent switched to a fallback model, Claude used to name the wrong model for its work; now it names the right one. New worktrees in a bare repository (a Git repository with history but no working files) sometimes started from local HEAD instead of the default branch, and unchanged subagent worktrees were sometimes not cleaned up. In scheduled Cowork cloud sessions, each subagent whose WebFetch needed a URL approval nobody was there to give used to wait five minutes; this release fixes more of those cases. When a Workflow resumes, already-completed `pipeline()` and `parallel()` agents no longer rerun and are served from the run's journal instead.

items.original:
Fixed new worktrees in a bare repository sometimes starting from local HEAD instead of the default branch, and unchanged subagent worktrees sometimes not being cleaned up
Fixed Claude naming the wrong model for a subagent's work after the subagent switched to a fallback model
Fixed more cases of scheduled Cowork cloud sessions waiting five minutes for each subagent whose WebFetch needed a URL approval that nobody was there to give
Fixed Workflow resume re-running already-completed `pipeline()` and `parallel()` agents instead of serving them from the run's journal

title.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段的 MCP 伺服器不再被同名設定蓋掉
title.en: MCP servers in cloud sessions are no longer replaced by same-named settings

body.zh-TW: 說好的設定用到一半被換掉，是雲端工作階段裡最難查的狀況。由雲端工作階段、或 SDK 的 `setMcpServers` 傳進來的 MCP 伺服器，以前跑到一半會被你自己設定裡同名的伺服器取代，現在不會。compaction（把舊對話濃縮成摘要）為了塞得下而略過最舊的訊息時，雲端工作階段和隊友以前不會告訴 Claude，現在會。用 Remote Control 搭配 `/resume` 切換對話後，`/resume` 清單不再留下空的「(session)」項目。Remote Control 的啟動模式訊息也講清楚了：按 `w` 會說新模式已存給這個資料夾，之後 `claude remote-control` 沿用它啟動時，會告訴你設定從哪來。
body.en: A setting that gets swapped out halfway through is one of the hardest things to track down in a cloud session. An MCP server passed in by a cloud session or by the SDK's `setMcpServers` used to be replaced later in the session by a same-named server from your own settings; it no longer is. When a compaction (condensing older conversation into a summary) had to leave the oldest messages out to fit, cloud sessions and teammates did not tell Claude; now they do. After switching conversations with `/resume` under Remote Control, the `/resume` list no longer keeps empty "(session)" entries. Remote Control's spawn-mode messages are clearer too: pressing `w` says the new mode is saved for the folder, and a later `claude remote-control` start that uses the saved mode says where it came from.

items.original:
Fixed an MCP server passed by a cloud session or by the SDK's `setMcpServers` being replaced later in the session by a same-named server from your own settings
Fixed cloud sessions and teammates not telling Claude when a compaction had to leave the oldest messages out of its summary to fit
Fixed Remote Control leaving empty "(session)" entries in `/resume` after switching conversations with `/resume`
Remote Control: Improved the spawn-mode messages: pressing `w` now says the new mode is saved for the folder, and a later `claude remote-control` start that uses the saved mode says where it came from

title.zh-TW: mod 的圖片在 iTerm2 畫得出來，停靠窗格最多佔 45% 寬
title.en: A mod's image draws in iTerm2, and docked panes stay within 45% width

body.zh-TW: 自己寫 mod（替 Claude Code 介面加料的擴充）的人，會碰到這兩處改動。在 iTerm2 3.5 以上、開啟全螢幕繪製時，mod 裡的 `Image` 以前只顯示 `alt` 替代文字，現在能畫出圖片。mod 停靠在旁邊的窗格，現在最多佔終端機寬度的 45%；就算寬度是從更寬的終端機沿用過來的，也照樣限制。⟦檯燈底座以前可能大到佔掉半張桌子，搬到小桌也維持原尺寸，現在底座最多佔四成多，留下的桌面給你寫字。⟧
body.en: If you write mods (extensions that add to Claude Code's interface), two changes affect you. In iTerm2 3.5 and later with fullscreen rendering, a mod's `Image` used to show only its `alt` text; it now draws the picture. A mod's docked pane now stays within 45% of the terminal's width, even when the width was kept from a wider terminal. ⟦A desk lamp whose base could hog half the desk, and kept that size when moved to a smaller desk, now takes up a bit over four-tenths at most, leaving the rest for your writing.⟧

items.original:
Improved a mod's `Image` to draw its picture in iTerm2 3.5 and later with fullscreen rendering, where it showed only its `alt` text
Changed a mod's docked pane to stay within 45% of the terminal's width, including a width kept from a wider terminal

title.zh-TW: VS Code 顯示正在執行啟動 hook，逾時訊息改先指向紀錄
title.en: VS Code shows when start-up hooks run, and timeout messages point to logs first

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 用 Claude Code、又設了啟動 hook（特定時機自動觸發的小程式）的人，以前開新工作階段時只看到畫面卡著。現在 SessionStart 或 Setup hook 執行期間，轉圈圈旁會顯示「Running start-up hooks」，螢幕閱讀器也會念出來。你的 `spinnerVerbs` 設定把內建動詞換成短字時，「Compacting...」以前會被截斷，現在完整顯示。工作階段沒有及時啟動、又沒有 hook 在跑時，提示訊息以前先叫你檢查登入和網路，現在改成先指向輸出紀錄，並列出可能原因。
body.en: If you use Claude Code in VS Code with start-up hooks (small programs triggered automatically at certain moments), opening a new session used to just look frozen. Now, while SessionStart or Setup hooks run, the spinner shows "Running start-up hooks", and screen readers announce it. When your `spinnerVerbs` setting swaps the built-in verbs for short ones, "Compacting..." used to get cut off; it now shows in full. When a session does not start in time and no hook is running, the message used to send you to sign-in and network first; it now leads with the output logs and lists possible causes.

items.original:
[VSCode] Added a "Running start-up hooks" spinner status, with a screen reader announcement, while SessionStart or Setup hooks run
[VSCode] Fixed the spinner cutting off "Compacting..." when your `spinnerVerbs` setting replaces the built-in verbs with short ones
[VSCode] Changed the message shown when a session does not start in time and no hook is running: it now leads with the output logs and lists causes instead of pointing to sign-in and network first

title.zh-TW: 自架 runner 三處卡關修好，刪除自架環境會說明影響
title.en: Three self-hosted runner snags fixed, and deleting a self-hosted environment explains the impact

body.zh-TW: 在自己機器上架 runner（替雲端工作階段實際跑任務的執行器）的團隊，這版修了三個卡住的地方。啟動腳本只把 stdout 分享給 runner 或協調程式時，只要設了 `TERM`，以前會以 `Resource temporarily unavailable` 失敗，這是 2.1.300 的退步。git 憑證程式或 askpass 程式透過 `GIT_CONFIG` 讀設定時，從 2.1.296 起存取不了儲存庫，現在好了。runner 在背景啟動的程式一直開著輸出時，協調程式以前會把 spawn-runner hook 誤報為逾時。管理頁面也修了兩處：Cloud environments 頁面不再用「installs packages」錯誤拒存既有環境；刪除自架環境時，會說明是什麼擋住刪除、刪了影響什麼。
body.en: Teams running a self-hosted runner (the executor that actually carries out tasks for cloud sessions on your own machine) get three snags fixed. A start script that shares only its stdout with the runner or orchestrator used to fail with `Resource temporarily unavailable` when `TERM` was set, a 2.1.300 regression. Since 2.1.296, repository access failed when a git credential helper or askpass program read its settings through `GIT_CONFIG`; that works again. When a runner the orchestrator started in the background kept its output open, the orchestrator used to report the spawn-runner hook as timed out. Two admin pages were fixed as well: the Cloud environments page no longer refuses to save an existing environment with an "installs packages" error, and deleting a self-hosted environment now says what blocks the delete and what it will affect.

items.original:
Self-hosted runner: Fixed a start script that shares only its stdout with the runner or orchestrator failing with `Resource temporarily unavailable` when `TERM` is set (a 2.1.300 regression)

title.zh-TW: Claude Tag 的 Slack 例行任務不再假裝已發文
title.en: Claude Tag routines in Slack stop pretending they posted

body.zh-TW: 在 Slack 用 Claude Tag（在 Slack 裡呼叫 Claude 的整合）設例行任務的人，最怕以為有發、其實沒發。在 Slack 私訊討論串設的例行任務，以前只要同串另一個任務重啟了對話，它就不再發文；現在兩個都會照常發。對話結束後，討論串裡的例行任務以前會回報成功卻沒發文，現在會略過這次執行並通知建立者。管理員這邊也有三處：「Add place」搜尋現在找得到 Claude 還沒加入的公開頻道，可直接從那裡設定；搬到別的 GitHub 帳號的儲存庫，可以重新加進存取組合；大型組織的管理頁面在頻道清單還沒載完時，也能編輯外掛、skill 和組合。
body.en: If you set up routines with Claude Tag (the integration that lets you call Claude inside Slack), the worst case is thinking a post went out when it did not. A routine set up in a Slack DM thread used to stop posting once another routine in that thread restarted the conversation; now both keep posting. Routines set up in a Slack thread used to report success without posting after the conversation ended; those runs are now skipped and the creator is told. Admins get three changes: the Add place search now finds public channels Claude has not joined so you can set one up from there, a repository that moved to another GitHub account can be added to access bundles again, and in large organizations plugin, skill and bundle edits work while the channel list is still loading.

[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag access bundles so a repository that moved to another GitHub account can be added again
[Claude Tag] Fixed a routine set up in a Slack DM thread no longer posting after another routine in that thread restarted the conversation; both now keep posting there
[Claude Tag] Fixed routines set up in a Slack thread reporting success without posting after the conversation ended; those runs are now skipped and the creator is told
[Claude Tag] Improved Claude Tag admin pages in large organizations so plugin, skill and bundle edits work while the channel list is still loading

title.zh-TW: Code Review 會審到最新的 commit，有未解決問題時不先說 LGTM
title.en: Code Review reviews the newest commit and skips LGTM while blockers remain

body.zh-TW: 在 GitHub 上讓 Claude 幫忙審 pull request（請人合併你改動的申請）的人，可能遇過審到一半又推了好幾次新改動。以前 Code Review 這時有時沒審到最新那個 commit，現在會。重審時，如果先前擋住合併的問題還沒解決，它也不再一開頭就寫 LGTM（看起來沒問題）。⟦請老師批改作文時你邊改邊交新版，以前老師可能批到舊版，錯字還沒訂正就先寫「很好」；現在他會批最新那份，錯字沒改完也不先誇。⟧
body.en: If Claude reviews your pull requests (proposals to merge your changes) on GitHub, you may have pushed several new changes while a review was still running. Code Review then sometimes skipped the newest commit; now it reviews it. On a re-review, it also no longer opens with LGTM (looks good to me) while earlier blocking findings are still open. ⟦Handing a teacher new drafts of your essay mid-grading used to mean they might mark an old one and write "great job" before the typos were fixed; now they grade the latest draft and hold the praise until the fixes are in.⟧

items.original:
[Code Review] Fixed Code Review sometimes not reviewing the newest commit when several pushes landed on a pull request during a review
[Code Review] Changed Code Review re-reviews so they no longer open with LGTM while earlier blocking findings are still open

title.zh-TW: 自動模式新增引導設定，工作階段記錄不再重複堆積分類脈絡
title.en: Auto Mode Adds Guided Setup, and Session Logs Stop Accumulating Classifier Context

body.zh-TW: 若想放手讓 Claude 自動執行任務，卻擔心它摸不清專案架構，現在有新工具能先幫它建立背景認知。輸入 `/auto-mode-setup` 指令，能讀取當前專案與近期工作階段（session，對話互動的生命週期），引導你教導自動模式熟悉執行環境。這項功能也支援 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry、Claude 應用閘道，以及停用遙測的工作階段。在自動模式運作時，安全分類器的上下文不再隨每次請求反覆寫入，有效縮減了記錄檔體積。⟦像新進助理報到時先詳讀交接手冊，之後每次跑公文就不必把厚厚整本規章重複釘在每張簽呈後面。⟧
body.en: If you want to let Claude execute tasks automatically but worry it will not understand your project architecture, a new tool can now help build its background context first. Running the `/auto-mode-setup` command reads your current project and recent sessions (the lifecycle of a conversational interaction), guiding you through teaching auto mode about your execution environment. This feature also supports Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, Claude app gateways, and sessions with telemetry disabled. While auto mode is running, safety classifier context is no longer rewritten with every request, significantly reducing log file size. ⟦Think of a new assistant reading a handover manual thoroughly upon onboarding; subsequent paperwork no longer requires stapling the thick rulebook behind every single sign-off sheet.⟧

items.original:
Added `/auto-mode-setup`: a guided setup that reads your project and recent sessions to teach auto mode about your environment, now also available on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, Claude apps gateway and telemetry-disabled sessions
Improved session file size in auto mode: the safety classifier's context is no longer stored with every request

title.zh-TW: `/claude-api` 新增代理人安全比對，AWS 環境優先使用專屬命令列
title.en: `/claude-api` Adds Agent Security Verification and Prioritizes Dedicated CLI on AWS

body.zh-TW: 在雲端管理自主代理人時，往往需要確認現有配置是否符合官方的安全規範。現在輸入 `/claude-api managed-agents-secure` 指令，能直接將託管代理人的設定與 Anthropic 公布的安全指南逐項對照，過程中完全不改動任何現有設定。在 AWS 平台的 Claude Platform 環境中，`/claude-api` 技能也會直接調用 `ant` 命令列工具，不再退回使用軟體套件或傳輸指令。⟦好比拿著官方消防清單巡視機房，逐條核對逃生門與滅火設備卻不任意更動擺設，通報時也直接使用專線對講機。⟧
body.en: When managing autonomous agents in the cloud, you often need to confirm whether current configurations comply with official security standards. Running `/claude-api managed-agents-secure` now audits managed agent settings item by item against Anthropic's published security guidelines without modifying any existing configuration. In Claude Platform environments on AWS, the `/claude-api` skill directly invokes the `ant` command-line tool instead of falling back to software packages or transfer commands. ⟦An inspector tours a server room with an official fire safety checklist, checking fire exits and extinguishers item by item without moving any equipment, and reporting updates directly over a dedicated radio.⟧

items.original:
Added `/claude-api managed-agents-secure`, which compares a Managed Agents agent's settings with Anthropic's published security guide, without changing anything
Updated the /claude-api skill to use the `ant` CLI on Claude Platform on AWS instead of falling back to the SDK or curl

title.zh-TW: 成品支援各分頁獨立連結，刪除確認改用數字鍵防誤按
title.en: Artifacts Support Independent Tab Links, and Deletion Confirmations Use Number Keys to Prevent Accidents

body.zh-TW: 請 Claude 產出包含多種檢視的成品時，常需要精準掌握各個畫面的位置與連結。現在索取成品連結時，Claude 會明確列出每個分頁檢視的完整連結，並特別提醒切換不同視圖時瀏覽器網址列不會改變。使用 `/artifacts` 刪除成品時，確認提示改為編號選單：按 1 或 Enter 會保留成品，按 2 則確定刪除，原本熟悉的 y、n 與 Esc 鍵也依然相容。⟦如同翻閱附有各章節書籤的展覽手冊，內頁清楚標明每個展示廳的對應代碼，撕下頁面時還需核對號碼牌防範失誤。⟧
body.en: When asking Claude to produce artifacts containing multiple views, you often need precise control over the location and link for each screen. Requesting artifact links now prompts Claude to explicitly list full URLs for every tab view, while noting that switching views will not update the browser address bar. When deleting artifacts via `/artifacts`, the confirmation prompt now uses a numbered menu: pressing 1 or Enter keeps the artifact, while pressing 2 confirms deletion, with familiar y, n, and Esc keys remaining compatible. ⟦Flipping through an exhibition guide with bookmarked sections reveals the exact code for each display hall, while tearing out a page requires matching a numbered stub to prevent mistakes.⟧

items.original:
Improved artifacts with several views: when you ask for links to them, Claude now writes out each view's link and explains that the address bar stays the same as you switch views
Changed the `/artifacts` delete confirmation to show numbered choices: 1 or Enter keeps the artifact, 2 deletes it, and y, n and Esc still work

title.zh-TW: 恢復長對話前提示用量佔比，用量查詢明確標示冷卻結束時間
title.en: Resume Prompts Warn of Usage Impact on Long Conversations, and Usage Queries Display Cooldown End Times

body.zh-TW: 打算接續過往暫停的冗長對話時，往往難以拿捏載入歷史脈絡會吃掉多少配額。Pro 與 Max 方案現在新增用量警示：當恢復非活躍對話會佔用 5 小時用量上限的顯著比例時，終端機會跳出確認提示。你可以選擇直接恢復，或者開啟乾淨的新對話，後續只要提及前次內容，Claude 就會主動回頭查閱。查詢 `/usage` 遇到資料頻率限制時，介面會清楚列出限制結束的時間點；Opus 5.5 在 `/fast` 視窗標題中的研究預覽標籤也已正式移除。⟦彷彿重新發動車輛前儀表板先提醒這段路將耗損多數油料，油槍跳停時也會亮出倒數計時告示。⟧
body.en: When planning to resume a lengthy paused conversation, it is often hard to gauge how much quota loading historical context will consume. Pro and Max plans now introduce a usage warning: if resuming an inactive conversation would take up a significant share of your 5-hour limit, the terminal displays a confirmation prompt. You can choose to resume directly or start a clean new conversation, after which Claude will proactively look back whenever you mention earlier context. When checking `/usage` hits a data rate limit, the interface clearly shows when the restriction ends; Opus 5.5's research preview label in the `/fast` window title has also been officially removed. ⟦Before restarting an engine, the dashboard warns that the planned trip will consume most remaining fuel, and a gas pump displays a countdown timer when it shuts off.⟧

items.original:
Added a warning on Pro and Max plans when resuming an inactive conversation would use a noticeable share of your 5-hour usage limit: resume anyway, or start a new conversation and Claude can look up the previous one if you refer to it
Improved `/usage` to say when a rate limit on usage data ends instead of "try again in a moment"
Removed the "(research preview)" label from the `/fast` dialog title on Opus 5.5

title.zh-TW: 擴充模組支援嚴格人工授權，唯讀判定與設定層級控制更精準
title.en: Extensions Support Strict Human Authorization, with Precise Read-Only Flags and Configuration Tier Control

body.zh-TW: 自己撰寫擴充模組攔截工具呼叫時，最需要掌控敏感操作的授權邊界。模組在 `tool.check` 中新增 `decider: "person"` 屬性，限定只有權限確認對話框或宿主回呼可以核准請求；在無人可詢問的環境下，會依照模組理由直接拒絕。事件參數也新增 `e.isReadOnly` 標記工具是否為唯讀。若有先執行的外掛跳過你的模組掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），記錄檔會明確寫出該外掛與事件名稱。模組的 `settings.read` 掛鉤現已能讀取每一層設定並覆寫合併值，將組織設定設為不可踰越的上限。外掛驗證指令也不再印出猜測掛鉤位置的文字。⟦類似機密門禁安裝雙重防線，危險操作非得由保全人員親自核章，各級主管的授權天花板也層層防堵。⟧
body.en: When writing extensions to intercept tool calls, controlling authorization boundaries for sensitive operations is critical. Modules add a `decider: "person"` property to `tool.check`, restricting approvals exclusively to permission confirmation dialogs or host callbacks; without an available human to ask, requests are denied directly with the module's reason. The event parameter also adds `e.isReadOnly` to flag whether a tool is read-only. If an earlier plugin bypasses your module hooks (small programs triggered by specific events), the log explicitly records the plugin and event names. The `settings.read` hook in modules can now read every configuration layer and override merged values, locking organizational settings as an inviolable ceiling. Plugin validation commands also no longer print text guessing hook locations. ⟦A high-security checkpoint deploys dual defense lines, requiring security personnel to stamp dangerous operations in person while executive authorization ceilings block unauthorized escalations.⟧

items.original:
Added a transcript line when a plugin that runs first skips one of your mod's hooks, naming the event and the plugin
Added `decider: "person"` to a mod's `tool.check` answer: only the permission dialog or a host's callback can approve the ask, and it is refused with the mod's reason where nobody can be asked
Added `e.isReadOnly` to a mod's `tool.check` event, set when the tool call is read-only
Changed mods' `settings.read` hooks to receive each settings layer and rewrite the merged settings, so a managed mod can make an organization's setting a ceiling, including the `cleanupPeriodDays` the retention sweep uses
Removed the notes from `claude plugin validate` that predicted where a mod's hooks would run

title.zh-TW: 模組重載失敗不再丟失舊版工具，同名按鈕點擊精準識別
title.en: Module Reload Failures Retain Older Tools, and Clicks on Duplicate Buttons Register Accurately

body.zh-TW: 在對話過程中調整自訂模組時，程式若出現語法錯誤常會打斷原本的工作流程。以前模組重新載入失敗時，會誤把原本正常載入的舊版工具與指令清空；現在載入失敗會完整保留既有版本，終端機也會清楚顯示載入狀態。畫面上標籤相同且未指定 `key` 的多顆按鈕，重新繪製後點擊事件不再無故遺失。在企業或受管制的設備上，`plugin-authoring` 技能分享模組時不會再卡在機密掃描。啟用工作階段中模組的提示改為純文字，換輪時保持可見，啟用當下也會清楚告知載入內容。⟦跟樂團更換曲譜一樣，新譜印錯時樂手繼續照著舊譜演奏而不中斷旋律，按鍵重複時也能確實聽見回饋。⟧
body.en: Adjusting custom modules during a conversation can easily disrupt workflows if a syntax error occurs. Previously, a failed module reload cleared out working older tools and commands by mistake; now, reload failures preserve existing versions intact while the terminal clearly displays reload status. When multiple buttons share identical labels without a specified `key`, click events are no longer lost after rerendering. On enterprise or managed devices, sharing modules via the `plugin-authoring` skill no longer hangs on secrets scanning. Prompts activating in-session modules have switched to plain text, remaining visible across turns and clearly reporting loaded content upon activation. ⟦Much like an orchestra changing sheet music, musicians keep playing from older scores when new prints contain errors without breaking the melody, and duplicate keystrokes still produce clear feedback.⟧

items.original:
Fixed a failed mod reload removing the tools and commands of the version that stays loaded, and its messages being wrong or silent about whether the previous version is still loaded
Fixed a click on a mod's button being lost when buttons with the same label and no `key` were redrawn unchanged
Fixed mod sharing in the built-in `plugin-authoring` skill stopping at the secret scan on machines with managed settings and on Team and Enterprise plans
Improved the lines shown when a mod written in the session loads, reloads or fails to load
Changed the question that turns on the mods Claude writes in a session to plain text with no link or session id; it stays up when a new turn starts, and Claude tells you what loaded when you turn them on

title.zh-TW: 技能重新整理只傳送異動項目，單一來源掛鉤設定數量上限
title.en: Skill Reloads Transmit Only Changes, and Single Sources Face Hook Limits

body.zh-TW: 專案掛載了大量自訂技能時，頻繁更新容易讓對話上下文被重複的說明文字佔滿。以前每次外掛重載都會把整份技能清單重複送出；現在執行 `/reload-skills` 只會傳送新增或異動的項目，對話壓縮後則會確實補送一次最新總表。為避免外掛無限擴充，單一來源在每個工作階段（session，對話互動的生命週期）最多能註冊 1,024 個掛鉤與 16,384 個匹配字元。技能的單次掛鉤觸發後不再誤刪其他技能的同名掛鉤；若政策禁止本機技能掛鉤，該技能也無法取得預設的授權工具。⟦宛如圖書館更新借閱目錄，館方只印出新進書目的補充清單，每個民間贊助單位能擺設的立牌總量也受到限制。⟧
body.en: When a project loads numerous custom skills, frequent updates can easily flood conversation context with redundant descriptions. Previously, every plugin reload resent the entire skill inventory; running `/reload-skills` now transmits only added or modified entries, while conversation compaction reliably resends a fresh full inventory. To prevent plugins from expanding indefinitely, a single source can register at most 1,024 hooks and 16,384 matching characters per session (the lifecycle of a conversational interaction). A skill's single-fire hook no longer deletes identical hooks from other skills upon triggering, and skills cannot obtain default authorization tools if policy bans local skill hooks. ⟦Like a library updating its catalog, staff print supplementary slips only for new arrivals, while capping the number of display stands each private sponsor can place.⟧

items.original:
Fixed resumed and cloud sessions sending Claude the whole skill list again each time plugins reloaded at startup
Fixed a skill's `once` hook also removing another skill's identical hook after it ran
Changed compaction to send Claude the skill list again afterwards; `/reload-skills` now sends only new or changed skills
Changed skill hooks: the skills of one source (a repo, your own folder, or a plugin) can register at most 1,024 hooks and 16,384 matcher characters per session
Changed skills under a policy that allows hooks from plugins only: a skill used in the main conversation whose hooks are kept out no longer gets its `allowed-tools`

title.zh-TW: 多個子代理並行運作更流暢，結束任務立即發送訊息不再失憶
title.en: Multiple Subagents Run More Smoothly in Parallel, Eliminating Memory Loss When Messaged Immediately After Tasks

body.zh-TW: 調派多個子代理分頭處理大型專案時，代理人之間的資訊傳遞十分關鍵。多個子代理同時執行時的反應靈敏度與處理吞吐量現已獲得顯著提升。以前子代理剛結束任務時，若立刻向它發送訊息或恢復執行，有時會遺忘上一刻的處理成果；這項暫存遺失的問題已經修好。在無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機畫面與視窗的執行模式）下，外掛也無法再藉由生成子代理來突破輪次上限或停機指令。代理人團隊在主工作階段核准關閉請求時，不會再誤把整個工具程式關掉；工具攔截逾時也不再覆蓋既有的拒絕理由。⟦正如接力賽跑的多位選手在各自跑道上全力衝刺，交棒瞬間接獲新任務能清楚銜接上一棒進度，裁判登記抵達時也不會吹哨中止整場賽事。⟧
body.en: When dispatching multiple subagents across large projects, information transfer between agents is critical. Responsiveness and processing throughput when running multiple subagents concurrently have improved significantly. Previously, messaging or resuming a subagent immediately after it finished a task sometimes caused it to forget its most recent output; this cache loss issue is now resolved. In headless mode (an execution mode without terminal windows or visual interfaces), plugins can no longer spawn subagents to bypass turn limits or stop commands. When an agent team approves a shutdown request in the main session, it no longer accidentally terminates the entire tool process, and tool interception timeouts no longer overwrite existing rejection reasons. ⟦Relay runners sprint along their respective lanes, taking on new tasks at the baton pass while carrying forward previous momentum, and the referee logging arrivals never whistles to abort the entire race.⟧

items.original:
Fixed a plugin keeping a headless run going past `--max-turns`, Stop, or ended input by spawning subagents or re-running a finished one
Fixed subagents sometimes forgetting their most recent work when they were messaged or resumed right after finishing
Fixed a PreToolUse hook's deny reason being replaced by a timeout error when an Agent SDK callback hook on the same tool call timed out
Fixed agent teams: approving a shutdown request from the main session no longer exits the whole CLI
Improved responsiveness and throughput when many subagents are running at the same time

title.zh-TW: 對話壓縮摘要列出過往工具名稱，磁碟空間不足不再遺失對話
title.en: Conversation Compaction Summaries List Past Tool Names, and Low Disk Space No Longer Discards History

body.zh-TW: 對話長度超過模型負荷而觸發自動壓縮時，清晰的摘要能幫助快速掌握先前的決策流程。按下 Ctrl+O 檢視對話記錄時，壓縮摘要現在會清楚列出先前呼叫過的所有工具名稱。環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW` 正式支援 `k` 與 `M` 單位後綴，數值超出範圍或被忽略時會主動發出警示。以前硬碟空間不足時，本機記錄清理程序在修剪檔案過程會弄丟對話，這項問題已經排除。在模型拒絕過長對話並進行壓縮的途中強制中斷，不會再噴出提示過長的錯誤，記錄畫面中按快速鍵跳轉也不再漂移。⟦比方會議記錄員把冗長發言裝訂成精簡備忘錄，封套詳細列出先前展示過的所有簡報檔案，儲藏櫃空間吃緊時也不會夾落任何一頁憑單。⟧
body.en: When conversations exceed model capacity and trigger automatic compaction, a clear summary helps you quickly grasp prior decisions. Pressing Ctrl+O to view transcripts now displays a compaction summary that explicitly lists the names of all previously called tools. The `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW` environment variable officially supports `k` and `M` unit suffixes, issuing proactive warnings if values fall out of range or are ignored. Previously, local log cleaners could drop conversations while trimming files under low disk space; this issue has been eliminated. Aborting mid-compaction after the model rejects an oversized conversation no longer throws prompt-too-long errors, and jumping with shortcut keys in transcript views no longer drifts. ⟦A recording secretary binds lengthy proceedings into a concise memorandum, listing every previously presented slide on the cover, while tight filing cabinet space never causes a single voucher to slip out.⟧

items.original:
Added the names of the tools called earlier to the compaction summary in the transcript view (Ctrl+O)
Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC` dropping messages from the saved transcript when the disk filled up while the file was being trimmed
Fixed a "Context limit reached" or "Prompt is too long" error after stopping a turn while Claude Code was compacting a conversation the API had rejected as too long
Fixed transcript mode's `{` and `}` landing the prompt on an inconsistent row, or off screen, instead of the transcript's first row
Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW=200k` silently setting a 100K window: the variable now accepts `k` and `M` suffixes like `--autocompact`, and warns when a value is out of range or ignored

title.zh-TW: 刪除外接磁碟新增安全確認提示，分離工作樹結束不再無預警刪除
title.en: External Drive Deletions Prompt Safety Confirmations, and Detached Worktrees Are Protected Upon Exit

body.zh-TW: 整理檔案或測試專案分支時，操作邊界十分敏感。對 `/Volumes`、`/media` 或 WSL 的 `/mnt/c` 等外接磁碟或頂層目錄執行 `rm -r` 時，會比照系統目錄跳出安全確認提示。使用 `claude --worktree` 時，若處於分離狀態或不同分支，結束工作階段不會擅自刪除工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能），確保未推送的提交安全無虞。修改工作目錄外檔案時，路徑改顯示 `~/` 或絕對路徑，不再出現冗長相對符號。Linux 沙盒路徑含中括號不再報錯，Windows 直接調用 `git.exe` 減少延遲。⟦恰似操作重型機具，倒車接近貨櫃時必響起蜂鳴器確認，卸下拖車時若有貨品也會鎖上插銷。⟧
body.en: When organizing files or testing project branches, operational boundaries are highly sensitive. Running `rm -r` on external drives or top-level directories such as `/Volumes`, `/media`, or WSL `/mnt/c` now triggers a safety confirmation prompt, matching the behavior for system directories. When using `claude --worktree` in a detached state or on a different branch, ending a session no longer arbitrarily deletes worktrees (Git's feature for running multiple parallel copies of the same project), keeping unpushed commits safe. When modifying files outside the working directory, paths now display as `~/` or absolute paths instead of lengthy relative notation. Linux sandbox paths containing square brackets no longer trigger errors, and Windows invokes `git.exe` directly to reduce latency. ⟦Operating heavy machinery sounds a warning buzzer when backing up toward cargo containers, and latching pins lock in place whenever a detached trailer holds goods.⟧

items.original:
Fixed sandboxed commands failing to start on Linux when a `sandbox.filesystem.denyRead` glob contains brackets that are not a character class, such as a `[user-id]` route folder
Fixed `rm -r` of a mounted drive or a folder at its top level (`/Volumes`, `/media`, WSL's `/mnt/c`) not getting the safety prompt that `rm -rf /Applications` gets
Fixed Write results and rejected edits showing a file outside the working directory as `../../…`; they now show `~/…` or the full path
Fixed `claude --worktree` removing the worktree and its branch without asking at exit when HEAD was detached or on another branch, which could lose commits
Fixed Bash and PowerShell deleting a large command's output file when it could not be copied to the session's tool-results folder, unless the disk is full
Windows: Improved git command start-up with a standard Git for Windows install by running its git.exe directly instead of through its cmd launcher

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制解除帳號限制，自訂代理閘道連線自動相容重試
title.en: Remote Control removes account restrictions, while custom proxy gateways automatically retry with compatibility

body.zh-TW: 透過不同終端或自訂伺服器閘道連接 Claude 時，環境參數的些微差異容易導致通訊中斷。遠端控制（Remote Control，讓桌面端與終端機同步的連線機制）以往在終端機登入不同帳號時會永久扣留桌面版的歷史紀錄，現在這項限制已正式移除。即使在付費方案開啟停用遙測，桌面版遠端連線也能順暢啟動。當自訂語言模型閘道回報不支援脈絡管理欄位時，客戶端會自動剔除不相容欄位重新遞送；自訂 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` 預設啟用工具搜尋，遇到協定拒絕時也會自動降級重試。登入後伺服器派發的遙測追蹤設定，在整個工作階段中不再被忽略。⟦猶如搭機跨國通訊時設備自動辨識當地頻寬，遇到格式不合便自動退回基礎封包重傳，切換臨時門號也不會反鎖漫遊紀錄。⟧
body.en: Connecting to Claude through different terminals or custom server gateways often leads to communication disruptions due to minor differences in environment parameters. Previously, Remote Control (a connection mechanism syncing the desktop client with the terminal) permanently withheld desktop history when logging in with a different account from the terminal, but this restriction has now been officially removed. Desktop remote connections now launch smoothly even when telemetry is disabled under paid plans. When a custom language model gateway reports unsupported context management fields, the client automatically strips incompatible fields and resends the request. Custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` settings enable tool search by default, and automatically fall back to retry upon protocol rejections. Telemetry tracking configurations assigned by the server after login are no longer ignored throughout the entire session. ⟦A roaming traveler’s device automatically detects local bandwidth during cross-border communication, falling back to basic packets for retransmission upon format mismatches, while switching to a temporary number never locks roaming history.⟧

items.original:
Fixed Remote Control permanently withholding a desktop conversation's history when a different account was signed in to the terminal
Fixed Remote Control failing to start from Claude Desktop when DISABLE_TELEMETRY or DO_NOT_TRACK is set on a paid plan
Fixed `context_management: Extra inputs are not permitted` errors behind LLM gateways; Claude Code now resends the request without that field
Fixed OpenTelemetry settings delivered through server-managed settings being ignored for the whole session after signing in during first-run setup or the first start after /logout
Improved how a remote session recovers its status when the server refuses a status update that carried other session data
Changed tool search to be on by default behind a custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`; a 400 or 422 from the gateway is retried without it

title.zh-TW: 模型切換與中斷不再排隊卡頓，一小時循環排程精準命中快取
title.en: Model switching and interruptions no longer queue or stutter, while one-hour recurring schedules accurately hit the cache

body.zh-TW: 急著在對話中切換模型或按下中斷鍵時，任何等待都會讓人感到拖泥帶水。在 SDK 與桌面版中，切換模型、傳送新訊息或送出中斷訊號，不再被擋在脈絡檢查後面苦候。讀取工具若卡在閒置管道或偽裝成圖片的裝置，按中斷鍵能立刻抽身。排定在一小時上限的 `/loop` 循環喚醒，修正了觸發時機，不再剛好錯過一小時快取（cache，把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接用）期限，避免喚醒時重新花費時間全量讀取對話。恢復大型對話的首次回應速度顯著加快，記憶體消耗也獲得改善。⟦就像專業調音台上的切換推桿，按下靜音瞬時切斷訊號而不必等待後台自檢，自動定時回放也能直接調用已暖機的母帶。⟧
body.en: When rushing to switch models or press interrupt during a conversation, any waiting feels sluggish. Across the SDK and desktop app, switching models, sending new messages, or issuing interrupt signals are no longer stalled behind context checks. If reading tools get stuck on idle pipes or devices disguised as images, pressing interrupt breaks free immediately. Scheduled `/loop` recurring wakeups set at the one-hour ceiling had their trigger timing fixed, preventing them from narrowly missing the one-hour cache expiration and avoiding full conversation re-reads upon waking. First-response speeds when resuming large conversations are noticeably faster, alongside improved memory consumption. ⟦Picture a professional audio mixing console where pressing mute instantly cuts signals without waiting for background self-checks, while automated timed playback directly retrieves pre-warmed master tapes.⟧

items.original:
Fixed model switches, messages and interrupts waiting behind a context usage check in SDK and desktop sessions
Fixed an interrupt not ending a Read that waits on an idle pipe or device named like an image
Fixed self-paced `/loop` wakeups scheduled at the 1-hour maximum firing just after the 1-hour prompt cache expired, so those wakeups no longer re-read the conversation uncached
Improved resume of large compacted sessions in SDK and headless mode: the first request after resuming is sent sooner
Improved memory use when sending requests in long or resumed conversations

title.zh-TW: 說明文字對齊真實參數行為，終端機輸入附註不再被刪節號截斷
title.en: Help text aligns with real parameter behavior, and terminal input notes are no longer cut off by ellipses

body.zh-TW: 在文字終端機敲打指令與回覆選項時，介面顯示若與底層行為不一致會讓人無所適從。輸入 `claude --help` 查詢時，包含 `--tools`、`--resume`、`--debug` 等多項參數與更新指令的說明，已經重新校對以貼合真實運作。當環境變數設為自動或未指定時，`/effort` 與輸入框旁的思考力度指示不再自行顯示猜測的數值。寬度小於 100 欄的窄視窗中，在預覽選單輸入附註時文字不再被刪節號無故截斷。在代理人清單中，滑鼠還沒放開就按 Ctrl+C，選取的文字現在不會只被清掉卻沒複製。⟦譬如手持電子紙閱讀器查閱產品指南，章節標題與實機按鍵逐一對應，在小螢幕邊欄手寫筆記時邊角文字也不會被擠落。⟧
body.en: Typing commands and choosing response options in text terminals can be confusing when the interface display does not match underlying behavior. When running `claude --help`, descriptions for multiple options and update commands—including `--tools`, `--resume`, and `--debug`—have been recalibrated to reflect actual operation. When environment variables are set to auto or left unspecified, `/effort` and the effort indicator next to the input box no longer display guessed values on their own. In narrow windows under 100 columns wide, entering notes in the preview menu no longer cuts off text with ellipses. In the agent list, pressing Ctrl+C before releasing the mouse button will no longer clear selected text without copying it. ⟦Imagine reading a product manual on an e-paper device where chapter titles match physical buttons one by one, and handwritten notes in small screen sidebars never have corner text cropped off.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `claude --help` text for `--tools`, `--resume`, `--debug`, `--json-schema`, `--disable-slash-commands`, `--system-prompt-snapshot` and `claude update` to match actual behavior
Fixed `/effort status`, `/effort ultracode` and the prompt's effort indicator showing a guessed effort level when `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL` is `auto` or `unset` and no level is sent
Fixed notes typed into a multiple-choice question with previews being cut off with "…" in terminals under about 100 columns, hiding what was typed (anthropics/claude-code#82768)
Fixed Ctrl+C in the agents view clearing a text selection without copying it when pressed before the mouse button was released

title.zh-TW: 啟動金鑰即時同步組織政策，桌面終端完整繼承設定檔環境變數
title.en: Startup keys instantly sync organization policies, and desktop terminals fully inherit profile environment variables

body.zh-TW: 配置團隊金鑰或切換專案設定時，最新政策與系統變數若未能立即套用，常會引發權限錯誤。以前在啟動時輸入金鑰或在 `/config` 切換自訂憑證，組織政策非得等滿一小時例行檢查才會更新；現在這項同步改為即刻刷新。在桌面版 Code 分頁執行 Bash 指令時，macOS 與 Linux 系統能完整繼承 `~/.zshrc` 等設定檔所匯出的環境變數。網路斷線後，`/privacy-settings` 不再提供不適用的隱私選項，使用者條款提醒也不會漏掉。使用 `claude -p` 載入設定時，警報也只聚焦阻礙啟動的關鍵錯誤。⟦形同換發新識別證後門禁閘門當場開通所有樓層，走進辦公區時個人置物櫃裡的專用工具也已全數備齊。⟧
body.en: When configuring team keys or switching project settings, failures to apply updated policies and system variables immediately often trigger permission errors. Previously, entering keys at launch or switching custom credentials in `/config` required waiting for an hourly routine check before organization policies updated. That sync now refreshes immediately. Running Bash commands within the desktop Code tab now fully inherits exported environment variables from profile files such as `~/.zshrc` on macOS and Linux. After network disconnections, `/privacy-settings` no longer offers inapplicable privacy options, and Terms of Service reminders are never omitted. When loading configurations with `claude -p`, alerts focus strictly on critical errors that obstruct startup. ⟦Consider a new security badge that instantly grants access to every floor at the turnstile, while personal lockers in the office already hold every necessary tool.⟧

items.original:
Fixed the organization policy not refreshing until the hourly check after approving an `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` at startup or switching "Use custom API key" in `/config`
Fixed unsandboxed Bash commands in Claude Desktop Code tab sessions on macOS and Linux not seeing environment variables exported in shell startup files such as ~/.zshrc
Fixed the Consumer Terms notice being skipped for a day or longer after a server error
Fixed `/privacy-settings` offering choices that may not apply to you after a network or server error
Improved the `claude -p` invalid-settings warning: a file that did not load lists only what stopped it, and long lists are capped per file

title.zh-TW: 雲端排程免除無效網址等待，第一輪對話跳過本機工具啟動卡頓
title.en: Cloud scheduling eliminates waiting for unapproved URLs, and initial conversation turns skip local tool startup stalls

body.zh-TW: 把任務排入雲端無人值守的工作階段時，若遇到需人工授權的流程往往會造成嚴重卡滯。在 Cowork 排程雲端工作階段中，子代理抓取網址若無人核准，現在不會再為每個代理人重複苦等五分鐘。開新對話的第一輪交流時，除非特別宣告必載，否則不再等待由網頁同步下來的本機標準輸入 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器，啟動更迅速。從斜線選單點選目錄外掛的技能，現已能順利當作指令執行，對話輸入框標記資料夾也不再遺失名稱。自架執行器若找不到儲存庫，也會明確提示專案名稱與聯絡窗口。⟦宛若夜間無人值守的氣象觀測站，收不到訊號的探針直接略過而不空轉乾等，儀器開機時也不必預先暖機未接通的感測器。⟧
body.en: Scheduling tasks into unattended cloud sessions often causes severe stalls when encountering steps that require manual authorization. In Cowork scheduled cloud sessions, subagents fetching URLs without approvals no longer wait five minutes repeatedly for each agent. During the first turn of a new conversation, unless explicitly declared as required, startup no longer waits for local standard input MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol allowing AI to connect to external tools) servers synced from the web, speeding up launches. Selecting directory plugin skills from the slash menu now executes them smoothly as commands, and tagging folders in the prompt input no longer drops names. If a self-hosted runner cannot find a repository, it clearly presents the project name and point of contact. ⟦An unmanned weather station at night skips probes that lose signal instead of idling, while powering on equipment no longer requires pre-warming disconnected sensors.⟧

items.original:
Fixed scheduled Cowork cloud sessions waiting five minutes again for each subagent whose WebFetch needed a URL approval that nobody was there to give
Fixed a claude.ai Directory plugin's skills not running as commands when picked from the "/" menu in Cowork cloud sessions
Improved cloud sessions: a new conversation's first turn no longer waits for the local (stdio) MCP servers of plugins synced from claude.ai, unless a server sets `alwaysLoad: true`
Self-hosted runner: Improved the error shown when the git host answers "not found" for a session's repository: it now names the repository and whom to ask
[Cloud sessions] Fixed folders in the composer's @ list showing no name in cloud sessions, where picking one added only a space instead of a mention

title.zh-TW: VSCode 背景代理改以狀態列精準呈現，啟動掛鉤時間不再計入逾時
title.en: VS Code background agents present cleanly in status lines, and startup hook runtimes no longer count toward timeouts

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 編輯器內與 Claude 協作時，大量背景任務的輸出常會淹沒重要的對話內容。現在背景子代理改在代理人卡片下方以一行進度文字呈現，不再把瑣碎步驟洗進聊天視窗，完整紀錄可至 `/tasks` 查閱。跨雲端平台與自訂閘道的對話面板，現在也支援模組的介面繪製。啟動時執行 `SessionStart` 指令掛鉤的時間不再計入一分鐘的逾時限制，最多放寬至 10 分鐘，有效避免子行程初始化逾時而啟動失敗。啟動中途關閉工作階段能即時結束行程，長時間開啟時模組繪圖不再消失，自訂封裝程序時過往對話也能正確列出。⟦比照劇場舞台的演出調度，後台換景的瑣碎走動只透過側邊燈號回報而不干擾主舞台，布幕拉下時排練行程也俐落收尾。⟧
body.en: Collaborating with Claude inside VS Code often causes conversation context to get buried under large volumes of background task output. Background subagents now appear as a single line of progress text below the agent card rather than flooding trivial steps into the chat window, with full logs accessible under `/tasks`. Conversation panels across cloud platforms and custom gateways now also support interface rendering for modules. Execution time for `SessionStart` command hooks (programs triggered by specific events) is no longer counted toward the one-minute timeout limit, expanding up to 10 minutes to prevent startup failures from subprocess initialization timeouts. Closing sessions midway through startup immediately terminates processes, module drawings no longer vanish when open for extended periods, and past conversations list correctly under custom packaged executables. ⟦Staging in a theater production reports backstage scenery shifts through side lights without disrupting the main stage, while lowering the curtain cleanly terminates rehearsal processes.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Added mod drawing in the chat panel for sessions on Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI and Microsoft Foundry, behind an LLM gateway, or with telemetry turned off
[VSCode] Fixed one cause of sessions failing to start with "Subprocess initialization did not complete within 60000ms": time a SessionStart command hook spends running no longer counts toward the limit, up to 10 minutes in total
[VSCode] Fixed a session closed while it was starting keeping its Claude Code process running until the start ended
[VSCode] Fixed a mod's drawings disappearing from a long-open panel until the next turn on machines that also run an older Claude Code
[VSCode] Fixed Past conversations hiding sessions when `claudeCode.claudeProcessWrapper` is set
[VSCode] Changed background sub-agents to show as one status line under their Agent card instead of streaming every step into the chat; the full transcript stays in /tasks

title.zh-TW: 頻道共享中途主動提示新對話，對話串外執行指令提供私密指引
title.en: Shared channels proactively prompt for new threads mid-task, and commands run outside threads provide private guidance

body.zh-TW: 在企業通訊軟體中標記 Claude 協同作業時，頻道屬性變動很容易打斷對話的進行。以前當頻道在任務執行途中變更為 Enterprise Grid 跨工作區共享時，Claude 會突然陷入沉默；現在它會主動留下一則提示，指引你在新對話串中重新標記並繼續工作。若有人在討論串外部直接輸入 `@Claude !fork` 分支指令，Claude 不再默不作聲，而是會發送一則私密訊息，清楚說明此指令只能在對話串內部執行。這讓跨群組溝通時的操作反饋始終透明可見。⟦恰如社區會議突然改為跨大樓聯合研討，主持人會立牌引導前往新會場發言，走廊上誤投的選票也會退還本人指引正確票匭。⟧
body.en: Tagging Claude for collaboration in enterprise messaging apps can easily disrupt active conversations when channel properties change. Previously, if a channel was converted to an Enterprise Grid cross-workspace shared channel midway through a task, Claude would suddenly fall silent. Now it actively leaves a prompt guiding you to mention it again in a new thread to resume work. When someone runs the `@Claude !fork` branching command directly outside a thread, Claude no longer stays quiet, but sends an ephemeral message clearly explaining that this command can only be executed inside a thread. This ensures operational feedback remains consistently transparent during cross-group communication. ⟦When a neighborhood meeting transitions into a cross-building seminar, the host puts up signs directing participants to the new venue, and ballots miscast in hallways are returned with guidance toward the correct ballot box.⟧

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude going silent in a thread when its channel becomes shared across Enterprise Grid workspaces mid-task; it now posts a one-time note to @-mention it in a new thread
[Claude Tag] Fixed `@Claude !fork` typed outside a thread getting no visible reply; Claude now shows you a private note saying to run it from inside a thread

title.zh-TW: 程式碼審查新增三種深度等級，支援 GitHub 全組織自動涵蓋
title.en: Code review introduces three depth tiers, supporting automated organization-wide GitHub coverage

body.zh-TW: 推廣團隊自動化程式碼審查時，不同重要性的專案往往需要彈性的審查深度。程式碼審查功能現在推出分級機制：團隊擁有人可針對整個組織選擇快速、標準（預設）或深度檢查，也可以針對特定核心專案個別設定不同層級。管理後台新增了自動審查功能，能一次納管 GitHub 組織下的全部儲存庫，之後新建立的專案也會自動加入，省去逐一手動設定的負擔。如果剛開啟審查功能隨即收到程式合併請求，系統不會再悄悄漏掉，而是會自動重新排程並完成檢查。⟦好似品管中心為不同產線設立抽驗機制，日用品快速過磅、高精密儀器深度探傷，新進產線全數自動建檔，剛開工送檢的樣品也能及時補驗。⟧
body.en: Rolling out automated code review across teams often calls for flexible review depth based on project importance. The code review feature now introduces a tiered system: team owners can select Fast, Standard (default), or In-depth checks for the entire organization, or customize distinct tiers for specific core projects. The administration console adds an automatic review option that brings all repositories under a GitHub organization into management at once, automatically including newly created projects to eliminate manual configuration overhead. If pull requests arrive immediately after enabling the review feature, the system no longer silently drops them, instead automatically rescheduling and completing the check. ⟦Quality inspection centers establish sampling mechanisms across production lines, quickly weighing daily goods while deeply scanning precision instruments, automatically cataloging new assembly lines, and promptly inspecting samples submitted right as shifts begin.⟧

items.original:
[Code Review] Added review levels to Code Review: Owners choose Quick, Standard (the default), or Deep for the organization, and can give individual repositories their own level
[Code Review] Added an option in Code Review admin settings to review every repository in a GitHub organization, including ones added later, without selecting them one by one
[Code Review] Fixed pull requests opened within a minute or two of an admin turning on Code Review being silently skipped; they are now retried and reviewed

title.zh-TW: /config 支援跨類別搜尋設定，即時修改並提示重啟
title.en: /config Supports Cross-Category Setting Search, Instant Edits, and Restart Prompts

body.zh-TW: 當你想調整 Codex 的各項參數，卻記不清具體設定名稱藏在哪個分類時，現在直接輸入 `/config` 就能解決。⟦彷彿走進大型量販店使用智慧導覽機，以前要一層層貨架慢慢找商品，現在直接搜尋關鍵字就能立刻取貨，機器還會貼心提醒哪些生鮮結帳後必須馬上冷藏。⟧輸入 `/config` 後，你可以跨越不同分類快速搜尋偏好設定，支援的選項能當場修改；哪些變更需要重啟，介面也會清楚標示，不必再自己猜測設定是否需要重啟。
body.en: When you want to adjust parameters in Codex but cannot recall which category a specific setting is tucked under, typing `/config` now solves the problem immediately. ⟦Picture using a smart kiosk in a large wholesale store: previously you had to browse through aisle after aisle of shelves to find an item, but now searching by keyword lets you pick it up immediately, and the machine even helpfully reminds you which perishables must be refrigerated right after checkout.⟧ After entering `/config`, you can quickly search for preferences across different categories, and supported options can be modified on the spot. The interface also clearly indicates which changes require a restart, sparing you from guessing whether a setting demands one.

items.original: Open `/config` to search preferences across categories, change supported settings immediately, and see which changes require a restart. (#52990, #53429)

title.zh-TW: 生成中途可即時追問轉向，中斷時同步停止程式碼與工具呼叫
title.en: Steer Generations Mid-Stream with Follow-Up Prompts, Halting Code and Tool Calls on Interrupt

body.zh-TW: 看著 AI 劈頭往錯誤的方向洋洋灑灑寫下去，你不用再乾等它講完廢話才能打字糾正。⟦好比教練在場邊即時對球員大喊變更戰術，以前只能眼睜睜看著整套戰術打完才能檢討，現在哨音一響場上球員立刻改變跑位，正在熱身準備上場的替補球員也會全部停下動作。⟧Codex 正在回答的當下，你可以隨時送出後續追問來即時引導思考方向。如果你決定中斷這次回應，正在執行的 Code Mode（逐格執行程式碼的模式）儲存格會立刻停止，連同其巢狀工具呼叫也一併結束，避免背景程序白白空轉。
body.en: Watching the AI dash off in the wrong direction with paragraph after paragraph, you no longer have to wait idly until it finishes before typing a correction. ⟦Think of a coach shouting tactical changes from the sidelines to players in real time: previously you had to watch the entire play run its course before reviewing it, but now players shift positions the moment the whistle blows, while bench substitutes warming up to enter the game halt their movements as well.⟧ While Codex is in the middle of responding, you can send follow-up prompts at any time to steer its train of thought on the fly. If you decide to interrupt the response, currently executing Code Mode (a mode that executes code cell by cell) cells stop immediately, and their nested tool calls are terminated alongside them, preventing background processes from spinning in vain.

items.original: Send a follow-up while Codex is responding to steer it immediately. Interrupting a turn also stops active Code Mode cells and their nested tool calls. (#51812, #51835)

title.zh-TW: /keymap 支援自訂前導鍵，快捷鍵提示常駐且語音靜音改為 F9
title.en: /keymap Supports Custom Leader Keys, Sticky Shortcut Prompts, and Moves Voice Mute to F9

body.zh-TW: 習慣用鍵盤快速叫出各種操作的讀者，現在調整自訂按鍵更加得心應手。⟦如同樂團指揮設定了預備拍，以前比劃動作稍縱即逝容易漏看，現在提示手勢會穩穩停在空中等你接招，也把靜音操作換到另一個指定琴鍵。⟧在 `/keymap` 設定中，你可以自由配置前導鍵（按下一組按鍵後等待後續指令的引導鍵），系統預設組合為 `Ctrl+X`。按下後跳出的快捷鍵提示會持續停留在畫面上，直到你做出選擇或取消為止。語音靜音功能則移到了 `F9` 按鍵。
body.en: Readers accustomed to invoking operations swiftly via the keyboard can now customize key bindings with far greater ease. ⟦Imagine an orchestra conductor establishing a preparatory beat: previously the fleeting gesture was easily missed, but now the cueing hand rests steadily in the air waiting for your response, while the mute control is reassigned to another designated piano key.⟧ Within `/keymap` settings, you can freely configure a leader key (a guiding key that waits for follow-up inputs once pressed), with the system defaulting to `Ctrl+X`. The shortcut prompt that appears after pressing it remains on screen until you make a choice or cancel. Voice muting has been moved to the `F9` key.

items.original: Configure a leader key in `/keymap`. The default is `Ctrl+X`, shortcut hints stay open until you choose or cancel, and voice mute moves to `F9`. (#52273)

title.zh-TW: /daemon 支援重啟背景伺服器，中斷前主動警告並自動重連
title.en: /daemon Supports Restarting Background Servers with Disruption Warnings and Auto-Reconnect

body.zh-TW: 當背景執行的伺服器連線卡住或需要重載時，你不必再大費周章手動終止處理程序。⟦就像大樓總電源維護前廣播通知，以前電閘一拉整棟直接斷電，現在管理員會先警告哪些電梯與設備即將暫停，重啟完畢後還會自動幫大家把照明重新接通。⟧現在從 `/daemon` 指令就能直接重啟受管的背景伺服器（常駐在系統底層默默運作的背景程序）。重啟前，Codex 會先跳出警告，提醒這次重啟可能會中斷哪些進行中的工作。確認執行後，系統會在伺服器重啟完成時自動重新連線，省去手動重連的繁瑣步驟。
body.en: When a background server connection hangs or requires a reload, you no longer need to go through the hassle of manually killing the process. ⟦Consider a building announcement prior to main electrical maintenance: previously throwing the main switch cut power to the entire building without ceremony, but now the superintendent first warns which elevators and facilities will temporarily halt, and automatically reconnects lighting once the restart completes.⟧ You can now restart managed background servers (daemons running quietly at the system level) directly from the `/daemon` command. Before restarting, Codex displays a warning outlining which active tasks might be disrupted. Once confirmed, the system automatically reconnects as soon as the server finishes rebooting, eliminating tedious manual reconnection steps.

items.original: Restart a managed background server from `/daemon`. Codex warns about work the restart could interrupt, then reconnects automatically. (#53173)

title.zh-TW: 唯讀工具支援平行執行，技能、記憶與對話紀錄查詢不再排隊
title.en: Read-Only Tools Support Parallel Execution: Skills, Memory, and Session History Queries No Longer Queue Up

body.zh-TW: 提問時需要 AI 同時調閱多項過往資訊的讀者，現在能感受到明顯更快的查詢反應。⟦跟圖書館調派多位館員同時分頭找書一樣，以前一個人要先找完歷史檔案才能去翻閱典藏技能，現在三位館員各自朝不同書架出發，找齊資料後一口氣交到你手上。⟧Codex 現在能夠平行（同時多工處理而不依序等待）執行彼此互不干擾的獨立唯讀工具。這項機制涵蓋了擴充技能檢索、記憶調閱，以及對話歷史紀錄查詢。這些互不衝突的讀取工作現在能同步展開，縮短等待回答的時間。
body.en: Readers whose questions require the AI to retrieve multiple pieces of past information at once will now notice noticeably faster query responses. ⟦A library dispatches multiple librarians to fetch books simultaneously: where one person previously had to search historical archives before checking archived skills, three librarians now head toward separate shelves at once and deliver everything into your hands the moment it is gathered.⟧ Codex can now execute mutually independent read-only tools in parallel (processing tasks concurrently without waiting in line). This mechanism covers skill retrieval, memory lookups, and session history queries. These non-conflicting read tasks now run concurrently, cutting down the wait time for answers.

items.original: Codex can run independent read-only tools in parallel, including skill, memory, and conversation-history lookups. (#52245)

title.zh-TW: Daybreak 模型對合格帳號預設啟用，codex exec 支援金鑰指定選用
title.en: Daybreak Model Enabled by Default for Eligible Accounts, with Key-Based Selection in codex exec

body.zh-TW: 想體驗最新 Daybreak 模型的讀者，只要帳號符合資格，打開程式就能直接用上。⟦宛若高鐵會員自動升級商務車廂，以前必須特地到櫃檯出示證件申請，現在符合條件的旅客刷票進站就能直接入座，在自動售票機輸入個人憑證也能順利劃位。⟧針對符合資格的帳號，Codex 現已預設啟用 Daybreak 模型。如果你習慣使用終端機指令 `codex exec` 執行任務，在伺服器提供存取權限的前提下，只要附上 OpenAI API 金鑰（存取雲端服務的通關密鑰），也能透過該指令自由選用 Daybreak 模型。
body.en: Readers eager to experience the latest Daybreak model can now use it right out of the box, provided their account is eligible. ⟦A high-speed rail membership automatically upgrades passengers to business class: where travelers once had to present identification at the counter to apply, eligible passengers can now swipe their tickets at the gate to take their seats directly, while entering personal credentials at automated ticketing machines also secures a seat smoothly.⟧ Codex now enables the Daybreak model by default for eligible accounts. If you prefer running tasks with the terminal command `codex exec`, you can also freely select the Daybreak model through that command by supplying an OpenAI API key (the secret pass for accessing cloud services), provided the server grants access.

items.original: Daybreak is enabled by default for eligible accounts. `codex exec` can also select it with an OpenAI API key when the server offers access. (#53701, #53717)

title.zh-TW: 對話串切換支援 /side 回到分支，重啟時完整恢復授權與網路許可
title.en: Thread Switching Supports /side to Return to Branches, Fully Restoring Authorizations and Network Permissions on Reopen

body.zh-TW: 頻繁在多個任務之間切換對話串（在同一專案中分頭進行的獨立對話紀錄）的讀者，現在不用擔心進度與設定跑位。⟦有如在辦公室借調多份專案公文，以前換個案子審核印章就得重新蓋過，現在換回舊案能直接調閱已批准的用印紀錄，派出去的公文回函也會精準送回當初發文的專案夾。⟧切換對話串後，你可以隨時輸入 `/side` 指令回到先前的旁支對話。如果切換前有尚未回覆完畢的提示詞，產生的答案也會準確送回當初提問的對話串。當你重新打開已保存的對話串時，先前擁有的權限與網路存取許可都會完整還原，同時依然遵守手動覆寫與現行的管理政策。
body.en: Readers who frequently switch between threads (independent conversation logs running concurrently in the same project) no longer need to worry about losing progress or configuration state. ⟦Handling multiple project dossiers in an office setting once required restamping approvals whenever you switched cases, but returning to an earlier case now pulls up previously approved seal records directly, and replies to dispatched memos return precisely to the originating project folder.⟧ After switching threads, you can type the `/side` command at any point to return to a previous side discussion. If a prompt was still generating when you switched, the resulting response is routed accurately back to the thread where the question originated. When reopening a saved thread, your previously granted authorizations and network access permissions are fully restored, while continuing to respect manual overrides and active administrative policies.

items.original:
Resuming a saved thread restores its permissions and network approvals, while respecting explicit overrides and current managed policy. (#53150, #53419, #53424)
Return to an existing side conversation with `/side` after switching threads. Answers to pending prompts also go back to the thread that asked. (#52184, #53436)

title.zh-TW: 網路代理加強防護：DNS 查詢前先審核、阻擋重複標頭與憑證別名繞過
title.en: Network Proxy Security Tightens: Pre-DNS Query Audits, Blocking Duplicate Headers and Credential Alias Bypasses

body.zh-TW: 在需要透過代理伺服器連接外部網路的環境中，這項更新替連線安全築起了更嚴格的防線。⟦猶如機場海關加強查驗流程，以前旅客報出目的地前不會先核驗護照，現在查驗官在查詢航線前就先確認出境許可，嚴查重複填寫的申報表，也不再讓換了別名的違禁證件繞過檢查站。⟧網路代理現在會在發起網域名稱查詢（將網址轉譯為伺服器位址的查詢）前，先行檢查該連線是否具備相應權限。代理伺服器也會主動拒絕帶有重複 `Host` 標頭的請求，並防止憑證別名繞過檢查掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），杜絕未經授權的潛在連線漏洞。
body.en: In environments that route external network traffic through a proxy server, this update erects a stricter line of defense for connection security. ⟦Customs inspectors at an airport checkpoint tighten screening procedures: where officers previously did not verify passports before travelers stated their destinations, inspectors now confirm exit permits before looking up flight routes, strictly scrutinize duplicate declaration forms, and block contraband credentials disguised under aliases from slipping past checkpoints.⟧ The network proxy now verifies whether a connection holds appropriate permissions before initiating a domain name query (resolving a web address into a server destination). The proxy server also actively rejects requests bearing duplicate `Host` headers and prevents credential aliases from bypassing check hooks (small routines triggered when specific events occur), plugging potential unauthorized connection loopholes.

items.original: The network proxy now checks permission before a DNS lookup, rejects duplicate `Host` headers, and prevents credential aliases from bypassing inspection hooks. (#51650, #52661, #53506)

title.zh-TW: Windows 支援快捷鍵貼圖，WSL 剪貼簿重複讀取並防止複製卡死
title.en: Windows Gains Image Pasting Shortcuts, While WSL Reuses Clipboard Readers and Prevents Copy Freezes

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 或 WSL（Windows 系統內建的 Linux 子系統）環境下操作終端機的讀者，剪貼內容時將順暢許多。⟦恰似換了一組靈敏的櫃檯讀卡機，兩組指定快捷鍵都能把文字與圖片直接貼進視窗；頻繁讀取時能共用讀取模組，複製操作也會逾時退出，不再一直卡住。⟧在 Windows 中，`Ctrl+V` 與 `Shift+Insert` 現在都能貼上文字與圖片。而在 WSL 環境下，連續多次貼上會重複使用剪貼簿讀取器；複製操作在遇到阻礙時則會逾時退出，不再無休止地卡死畫面。
body.en: Readers running terminals under Windows or WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux) will experience far smoother clipboard workflows. ⟦Upgrading to a responsive card reader at a checkout counter allows two designated shortcuts to feed both text and images straight into the window, frequent scans share the reader module, and stalled copy operations time out instead of hanging indefinitely.⟧ On Windows, both `Ctrl+V` and `Shift+Insert` can now paste text and images. Under WSL, successive pastes reuse the clipboard reader, while copy operations encountering obstacles time out gracefully rather than freezing the screen indefinitely.

items.original: On Windows, `Ctrl+V` and `Shift+Insert` paste text as well as images. On WSL, repeated pastes reuse the clipboard reader, and copy attempts time out instead of hanging. (#53224, #52967, #53453)

title.zh-TW: 指令輸出修復：本地與遠端傳輸更穩，codex exec 不再重複印出差異
title.en: Command Output Fixes: Steadier Local and Remote Transfers, codex exec Stops Reprinting Diffs

body.zh-TW: 經常在終端機執行本機指令或遠端遙控工作的讀者，這次更新修復了多項令指令卡住或資訊混亂的輸出問題。⟦宛如貨運物流中心整頓了出貨流程，以前只要下游包裝箱還沒封口，送貨司機就算卸完貨也只能在原地枯等，現在確認卸貨完成就能迅速出發，晚到的包裹也能妥善入庫而不被遺漏。⟧以前執行本機指令時，只要底層的子行程（由主程式衍生出來獨立處理任務的分支程式）沒有關閉輸出管道，整個指令就會乾等而不肯結束。現在本地指令在工作完成後能迅速結束。執行遠端指令時，晚到的輸出內容現在會妥善保留，確保最後一次輪詢時依然能完整收集。使用 `codex exec` 執行無關指令後，終端機也不會再重複印出先前的檔案差異清單。
body.en: For readers who regularly run local commands or remote tasks in the terminal, this update resolves several output glitches that previously hung commands or cluttered information. ⟦A freight logistics hub overhauls its shipping workflow: previously, as long as downstream packing crates remained unsealed, delivery drivers had to wait idly on site even after finishing unloading, but now drivers depart promptly once unloading is confirmed, and late-arriving parcels are safely warehoused rather than missed.⟧ Previously when running local commands, as long as underlying subprocesses (child processes spawned by the main program to handle tasks independently) kept output pipes open, the overall command would stall indefinitely rather than terminate. Local commands now exit promptly once their work is done. When executing remote commands, late-arriving output is now safely retained, ensuring it is fully collected during the final poll. Running unrelated commands via `codex exec` also no longer causes the terminal to reprint previous file diffs.

items.original:
Local commands finish promptly when a child keeps an output pipe open. Remote commands preserve late-arriving output so the final poll can still collect it. (#52652, #53331, #53622)
`codex exec` no longer prints the same file diff again after an unrelated command. (#53444)

title.zh-TW: 隨附技術文件更新：收錄 GPT-6 遷移指引與 Linux 沙箱架構說明
title.en: Bundled Documentation Update: GPT-6 Migration Guide and Linux Sandbox Architecture Details

body.zh-TW: 正在規劃將專案升級至新世代模型，或關注系統底層安全防護的讀者，現在能從隨附文件中查閱更詳盡的官方指南。⟦正如工廠設備手冊換上新版擴建指南，不僅詳細列出升級新型機具時的運轉特性與資料所在地考量，也公開了安全防護罩如何隔絕危險區域並過濾高壓氣流。⟧隨附的 OpenAI 文件已更新針對 GPT-6 系列模型的遷移指引，詳細說明了各模型特定的推理特性、外部工具使用方式，以及資料駐留（資料儲存與處理的地理位置）相關考量。隨附說明也進一步釐清了 Linux 沙箱機制的運作方式，詳細介紹系統如何透過 bubblewrap 達成檔案系統隔離，並藉由 seccomp 進行系統呼叫過濾。
body.en: Readers planning to upgrade projects to next-generation models or keeping an eye on low-level system security can now consult more detailed official guidance in the bundled documentation. ⟦A factory equipment manual swaps in a fresh expansion guide, not only detailing the operational characteristics and data location considerations when upgrading to new machinery, but also revealing how safety shields isolate hazardous areas and filter high-pressure airflow.⟧ The bundled OpenAI documentation updates migration guidance for the GPT-6 model family, detailing model-specific reasoning characteristics, external tool usage, and data residency (the geographic location where data is stored and processed) considerations. The bundled documentation also clarifies how the Linux sandbox mechanism operates, detailing how the system achieves filesystem isolation through bubblewrap and filters system calls via seccomp.

items.original:
Updated the bundled OpenAI Docs guidance for migrations to the GPT-6 family, including model-specific reasoning, tool use, and data residency considerations. (#51768)
Clarified how the Linux sandbox uses bubblewrap for filesystem isolation and seccomp for syscall filtering. (#52610)

title.zh-TW: 安裝包體積縮減，改用 Codex 的標準 shell 執行器並提示設定遷移
title.en: Package Size Reduced with Codex's Standard Shell Runner and Config Migration Notice

body.zh-TW: 在 Linux 與 macOS 環境下安裝或更新 Codex 的讀者，這次會發現下載更輕盈且底層執行器更單純。⟦與出差輕裝上陣的概念相同，以前行李箱裡硬塞了一整套自備工具組，現在改用原有的標準工具，並把非必要的裝飾吊牌全數卸下，讓行李箱體積與重量減輕不少。⟧官方透過從安裝二進位檔中剝除符號（除錯用的內部名稱標籤），縮減了 Linux 與 macOS 版本的安裝套件體積，原始建置產物則依然保留完整符號。在執行架構上，Codex 現在改用 Codex 的標準 shell 執行器（負責執行命令的工具），不再隨附修補版的 `zsh`。如果既有設定仍包含已淘汰的 shell 標記，系統會跳出遷移通知協助你平順過渡。
body.en: Readers installing or updating Codex on Linux and macOS will find lighter downloads and a simpler underlying runner. ⟦A business traveler packs light under the same principle: rather than stuffing a custom toolkit into a suitcase, they rely on existing standard tools and strip away nonessential decorative tags, significantly reducing suitcase size and weight.⟧ The team reduced package sizes for Linux and macOS releases by stripping symbols (internal name labels used for debugging) from installation binaries, while raw build artifacts still retain full symbols. In terms of execution architecture, Codex now switches to Codex's standard shell runner (a tool responsible for executing commands), no longer bundling a patched `zsh`. If existing configurations still contain deprecated shell flags, the system displays a migration notice to help you transition smoothly.

items.original:
Codex now uses its standard shell executor and no longer bundles a patched `zsh`. Configurations using the retired shell flags receive a migration notice. (#52160, #52213)
Reduced Linux and macOS release package size by stripping symbols from packaged binaries while preserving them in the original build outputs. (#52178)

title.zh-TW: 終端機顯示多行提問不再當機
title.en: Terminal Displaying Multiline Prompts No Longer Crashes

body.zh-TW: 當你在文字視窗等待背景任務，途中跳出落落長的確認提問時，畫面不會再突然卡死關閉。以前遇到非同步提問（程式在背後運作時插進來詢問意見的對話）包含多行文字，終端機文字介面常會直接當機。這個問題現在已經修好，訊息裡的換行排版會原樣保留，附帶的超連結完整網址也不會遺失。以前常因為介面當機而看不到完整問題，現在長內容與跳轉連結都能順利讀取。
body.en: When you wait for background tasks in a text window and a lengthy confirmation prompt pops up along the way, the screen will no longer suddenly freeze and close. Previously, when asynchronous prompts (dialogues that interrupt to ask for input while programs run in the background) contained multiline text, the terminal text interface often crashed directly. This issue is now fixed, with line breaks in messages preserved as formatted and full URLs in attached hyperlinks no longer lost. While users previously often missed full questions due to interface crashes, long content and redirect links can now be read smoothly.

items.original: Fixed a TUI crash when asynchronous questions contain multiple lines, preserving line breaks and complete hyperlink destinations. (#51866)

title.zh-TW: 命令列啟動不再因背景伺服器設定不同而失敗
title.en: Command-Line Startup No Longer Fails Over Differing Background Server Settings

body.zh-TW: 如果你習慣讓工具在背後持續運作，開新視窗輸入指令時，不必再擔心程式卡在開頭進不去。以前只要正在執行的背景伺服器與命令列介面（CLI，用文字指令操作的工具）預設設定不同，啟動就會報錯失敗。現在相容性檢查只會在命令列明確覆寫功能時才進行，啟動失敗的問題已經修好。以前常因預設值不同而被擋在門外，現在就算背景設定有別也能順利開啟。
body.en: If you are used to letting tools run continuously in the background, you no longer need to worry about programs getting stuck at startup when entering commands in a new window. Previously, whenever the running background server and the command-line interface (tools operated with text commands) had different default settings, startup would fail with an error. Now, compatibility checks only run when the command line explicitly overrides features, and the startup failure issue has been fixed. While users were previously locked out due to differing default values, the tool can now launch smoothly even when background configurations differ.

items.original: Fixed startup failures caused by differences between a running background server's feature settings and CLI defaults. Compatibility checks now apply only to explicit command-line feature overrides. (#52648)

title.zh-TW: 支援管理 Git 工作樹，平行開發多分支
title.en: Support for Managing Git Worktrees to Develop Multiple Branches in Parallel

body.zh-TW: 當你想在同一個專案同時開發不同功能，又不想頻繁切換分支打斷進度時，現在可以在受信任的本機專案中使用專屬工具。只要開啟工作樹功能，AI 就能直接建立並列出託管的 Git 工作樹（worktree，讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）。⟦好比在圖畫紙旁多鋪一張描圖紙，以前想畫草稿必須擦掉原本的線條，現在能同時畫兩張草圖而且隨時對照。⟧
body.en: When you want to develop different features in the same project simultaneously without interrupting progress by frequently switching branches, dedicated tools are now available in trusted local projects. Once the worktree feature is enabled, the AI can directly create and list managed Git worktrees (parallel copies of the same project managed by Git). ⟦Picture laying an extra sheet of tracing paper beside your drawing paper: whereas sketching a new idea previously meant erasing original lines, you can now work on two drafts simultaneously and cross-reference them at any time.⟧

items.original: Add tools for creating and listing managed Git worktrees from trusted local projects when the worktrees feature is enabled. (#50148)
