title.zh-TW: 按鍵釘選重要任務，集中在置頂群組
title.en: Pin Important Tasks via Keystroke to Group Them at the Top

body.zh-TW: 當你在代理人的命令中心同時追蹤好幾個任務，想把當前最重要的項目固定在顯眼處時，現在只要按下鍵盤上的 p 鍵就能快速釘選。只要伺服器支援這項功能，被釘選的任務就會統一歸入共用的 Pinned 群組中，方便你隨時回頭檢視這些項目的處理進度。⟦像在辦公白板上貼便利貼，以前待辦項目一多很容易被新任務洗下去，現在能把要緊的事釘在最上方的專用區域，一眼就能看清。⟧
body.en: When tracking multiple tasks simultaneously in the agent command center and looking to keep the most critical items prominent, you can now press the p key on your keyboard to pin them quickly. As long as the server supports this capability, pinned tasks are consolidated into a shared Pinned group, making it easy to review their progress at any time. ⟦Like placing sticky notes on an office whiteboard, where a growing list of to-dos once got buried under incoming tasks, you can now pin pressing items to a dedicated top section for immediate visibility.⟧

items.original: Pin tasks in the agent Command Center with `p` and keep them in a shared Pinned group when supported by the server. (#51500)

title.zh-TW: 終端介面複製更靈活，滾輪速度隨意調
title.en: Flexible Terminal UI Copying and Adjustable Scroll Speed

body.zh-TW: 在終端介面翻看長篇對話時，如果你想快速抓出某段程式碼或重點回覆，現在的操作方式更加順手。你可以直接輸入 /copy 來選取並複製對話紀錄區塊，或是按下 Ctrl+Insert 複製目前滑鼠反白的文字。如果覺得終端介面捲動太快或太慢，還可以在設定中加入 tui.mouse_scroll_speed 調整滑鼠滾輪的捲動速度。⟦彷彿看長篇電子書時換了順手的翻頁器，以前選字複製經常受限於視窗操作，現在能精準抓取段落還能微調捲動步調。⟧
body.en: When browsing long conversations in the terminal UI, extracting specific code snippets or key responses is now much smoother. You can enter /copy to select and copy conversation blocks, or press Ctrl+Insert to copy text currently highlighted by the mouse. If the terminal UI scrolls too fast or too slow, you can also add tui.mouse_scroll_speed in the settings to adjust the mouse wheel scroll speed. ⟦Think of switching to a handy page-turner while reading a long e-book, where selecting and copying text was once constrained by window interactions, but you can now capture exact passages and fine-tune your scrolling pace.⟧

items.original: Navigate and copy transcript blocks with `/copy`, use `Ctrl+Insert` to copy selections, and tune mouse-wheel scrolling with `tui.mouse_scroll_speed`. (#50434, #50215, #50209)

title.zh-TW: 終端各類提示網址皆可點，跨行連結不中斷
title.en: Clickable Terminal Prompt URLs with Unbroken Multi-Line Links

body.zh-TW: 當 AI 在終端機跳出確認提問或警告訊息並附上參考網址時，你現在不必再手動反白複製。不論網址出現在確認標頭、提問清單、警告橫幅、驗證提示，還是 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）提示中，都能直接點擊開啟。就算網址太長被終端機自動折到下一行，連結依然能完整點開而不會斷成兩截。⟦好似在紙本書的註腳旁附上完整 QR 碼，以前長網址印成兩行容易抄錯，現在直接掃描就能連到正確網頁。⟧
body.en: When the AI displays confirmation questions or warning messages in the terminal with reference URLs, you no longer need to manually highlight and copy them. Whether a URL appears in a confirmation header, question list, warning banner, verification prompt, or an MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol that connects AI to external tools) prompt, you can click to open it directly. Even if a URL is long and wrapped to the next line by the terminal, the link still opens completely without breaking in two. ⟦A printed book includes a complete QR code next to its footnotes: whereas long URLs split across two lines were once prone to copying errors, scanning directly now opens the exact page.⟧

items.original: Make URLs clickable in approval headers, questions, MCP prompts, warnings, banners, and verification prompts, including when links wrap across lines. (#51439, #51449, #51450, #51451, #51452, #51458)

title.zh-TW: 自訂模型支援聯網搜尋，可開啟遠端壓縮
title.en: Custom Models Gain Web Access and Remote Compaction Support

body.zh-TW: 如果你串接了相容於 Responses 介面的自訂模型供應商，現在能替它們啟用更多進階能力。你可以直接為這些自訂模型設定即時聯網功能（live web access），讓模型取得最新網路資訊。還可設定遠端壓縮能力（remote compaction），讓對話內容的濃縮由遠端處理。⟦如同替外聘的專家助理配置即時百科與秘書，你可以替他配上查詢新資料的工具，也可以安排秘書協助濃縮紀錄。⟧
body.en: If you connect custom model providers compatible with the Responses API, you can now enable more advanced capabilities for them. You can configure live web access directly for these custom models so they can retrieve the latest web information. You can also configure remote compaction so that conversation summaries are processed remotely. ⟦Equipping an external expert assistant with an updated encyclopedia and a secretary allows you to provide tools for looking up fresh data while also assigning a secretary to condense conversation logs.⟧

items.original: Configure live web access and remote compaction capabilities for custom Responses-compatible model providers. (#50459)

title.zh-TW: JavaScript 支援非同步串流，程式模式工具可排序
title.en: JavaScript Async Streaming Support and Ranked Tools in Code Mode

body.zh-TW: 在撰寫自動化腳本或使用程式模式（Code Mode）處理大量工具時，開發體驗得到了進一步強化。這次新增了 JavaScript 輔助工具，能在多個非同步操作（Promise）各自完成時立即串流回傳結果，不必苦等全部做完才一次收到。此外在 Code Mode 中，你還可以主動啟用排序工具搜尋功能，讓系統依照關聯度推薦最合適的工具。⟦跟外送點餐即時收到每道菜出餐通知一樣，以前得等整桌菜炒完才送上來，現在哪道先好就能先拿到並更快找到餐具。⟧
body.en: When writing automation scripts or handling numerous tools in Code Mode, the development experience is further enhanced. New JavaScript helper utilities now stream results back immediately as multiple asynchronous operations (Promise instances) complete individually, without waiting for every task to finish. Furthermore, in Code Mode, you can actively enable ranked tool search so the system recommends the most relevant tools by relevance. ⟦Food delivery orders send real-time alerts as each dish leaves the kitchen: instead of waiting for the entire table of dishes to be cooked before serving, you receive each item as it is ready and locate utensils much faster.⟧

items.original: Add JavaScript helpers for streaming promise results as they settle, plus opt-in ranked tool search in Code Mode. (#51126, #51209)

title.zh-TW: 終端對話遵循預設模型，保留手動指定參數
title.en: Terminal Sessions Follow Default Models While Preserving Manual Overrides

body.zh-TW: 當你開啟新的終端對話時，系統現在會優先採用伺服器端設定的模型與推理摘要預設值。以前新建對話可能忽略伺服器給定的預設配置，現在系統會完整遵循這些預設選項。假使你在啟動時手動傳入了特定參數，系統也會優先保留你明確指定的覆寫值，不會被預設設定強行蓋過。⟦宛若走進連鎖餐廳用餐，以前廚房常搞錯標準配方，現在預設會照標準菜單出餐，但也依然遵循你點單時註明的客製需求。⟧
body.en: When starting a new terminal conversation, the system now prioritizes server-configured defaults for models and reasoning summaries. Whereas creating a new conversation previously could ignore default server settings, the system now adheres fully to these defaults. If you manually pass specific parameters at launch, the system also prioritizes and retains your explicit override values instead of overwriting them with defaults. ⟦Dining at a chain restaurant illustrates the change: while the kitchen previously could mix up standard recipes, it now serves according to the standard menu by default while still honoring any custom preferences specified on your order.⟧

items.original: Respect server model and reasoning-summary defaults for new TUI threads while retaining explicit launch overrides. (#50013, #50811, #50913)

title.zh-TW: 套用補丁保留換行格式，Windows 檔案不跑版
title.en: Patch Application Preserves Line Endings Without Corrupting Windows Files

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 環境下修補程式碼時，你不再需要特地手動指定設定來維持原本的換行格式。以前執行 apply_patch 更新檔案時，若未額外開啟選項，既有的 CRLF（Windows 標準換行符號）可能會被改掉；現在 apply_patch 會自動保留檔案原有的換行格式。這個問題已經修好，能避免檔案送出版控時多出整份換行差異。⟦跟維護舊文件一樣，以前每次送出修訂都得額外勾選保留原本排版，否則換行符號會被洗掉；現在直接套用也能原樣留存。⟧
body.en: When patching code in Windows environments, you no longer need to manually specify settings to preserve original line endings. Previously, updating files with apply_patch could alter existing CRLF line endings (the standard Windows line-ending format) unless an extra option was enabled; apply_patch now automatically preserves the file's original line endings. This issue is resolved, preventing unintended diffs across the entire file when committing changes to version control. ⟦Maintaining legacy documents once required ticking an extra box on every revision to keep original formatting from getting overwritten, but applying edits now preserves line endings automatically.⟧

items.original: Preserve existing CRLF line endings in `apply_patch` updates without requiring an opt-in. (#51203)

title.zh-TW: Linux 沙箱啟動防護強化，嚴格落實檔案隔離
title.en: Enhanced Linux Sandbox Startup Protections and Enforced File Isolation

body.zh-TW: 在 Linux 環境中使用安全沙箱隔離執行環境時，系統修復了多項攸關啟動與檔案存取的安全限制。當設定了多個禁止存取的檔案時，沙箱以前可能無法順利啟動，現在啟動流程已修復。沙箱現在會拒絕可被寫入的建構執行檔。也修正了 ripgrep 設定，確保搜尋配置不會削弱禁止規則（deny-glob）的檔案遮罩防護。⟦就像保險庫修好了門禁名單一多就卡住的問題，也拒用能被改動的門禁安裝工具，並讓查找物品的設定不會削弱禁止存取的名單。⟧
body.en: When using the security sandbox to isolate execution environments on Linux, the system fixed several security constraints related to startup and file access. The sandbox previously could fail to start when multiple denied files were configured, but this startup process is now fixed. Sandboxes now reject writable executables used to construct the sandbox. The ripgrep configuration was also corrected to ensure search settings do not weaken deny-glob file mask protections. ⟦A bank vault fixes a stall that occurred whenever access denial lists grew too long, rejects modifiable installation tools, and ensures search settings never undermine restricted lists.⟧

items.original: Fix Linux sandbox startup with multiple denied files, reject writable sandbox-construction executables, and keep ripgrep configuration from weakening deny-glob masks. (#50059, #51211, #51407, #51527)

title.zh-TW: Windows 10 磁碟存取恢復，沙箱暫存權限一致
title.en: Restored Windows 10 Drive Access and Consistent Sandbox Temp Permissions

body.zh-TW: 如果你在 Windows 10 系統上執行指令或使用沙箱隔離環境，先前遇到的路徑找不到與權限錯誤已獲得修復。現在恢復了一般磁碟代號（如常見的 C 槽與 D 槽）檔案存取能力，讀寫既有檔案不再出錯。Windows 沙箱內的暫存目錄權限也調整為與子行程（subprocess，由主程式啟動的附屬運作程序）環境一致，避免程式在執行時因權限不符而卡住。⟦有如拿到了相符的門禁卡，以前在 Windows 10 容易讀不到磁碟或被暫存目錄擋在門外，現在權限一致後各項操作都能順利通行。⟧
body.en: If you run commands or use sandboxed environments on Windows 10, previously encountered missing path and permission errors are now resolved. Standard drive letter file access (such as common C: and D: drives) is restored, preventing errors when reading or writing existing files. Permissions for temporary directories inside the Windows sandbox are also aligned with environments of subprocesses (child processes started by the main program), preventing programs from hanging due to permission mismatches during execution. ⟦Obtaining a matching keycard resolves previous hurdles on Windows 10 where drives were unreadable or temp directories locked you out, ensuring all operations proceed smoothly with consistent permissions.⟧

items.original: Restore ordinary drive-letter file access on Windows 10 and match Windows sandbox temp permissions to the child process environment. (#51511, #51512)

title.zh-TW: 遵循伺服器建議時間重試
title.en: Retrying Requests Following Server Recommendations

body.zh-TW: 使用 Codex 時，送出的請求或即時連線若失敗，你可能需要等一段時間才能重試。Responses（傳送模型請求的介面）的可重試失敗，現在會遵循伺服器的 Retry-After 建議。這個標頭會告訴用戶端應等待多久再試。WebSocket（維持雙向即時通訊的連線）的可重試失敗也適用：依照建議時間等待後再重試。⟦好比撥打客服電話遇到忙線，聽到語音建議稍後再撥，就依照建議等候，再重新撥打。⟧
body.en: When using Codex, if a sent request or real-time connection fails, you may need to wait for a while before retrying. Retryable failures for Responses (the interface for sending model requests) now follow the server's Retry-After recommendation. This header tells the client how long to wait before trying again. Retryable failures for WebSocket connections (which maintain two-way, real-time communication) also follow this rule by waiting for the suggested duration before retrying. ⟦When dialing a busy customer service line, a caller follows the automated voice prompt to wait for the suggested time before calling back.⟧

items.original: Honor server `Retry-After` advice for retryable Responses and WebSocket failures. (#50418, #51440)

title.zh-TW: Windows 安裝程式附帶數位簽章，版本下載更安全
title.en: Windows Installers Include Digital Signatures for Safer Version Downloads

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 下安裝或更新系統時，安裝腳本與版本下載機制現在具備更高的安全性與相容性。Windows 發行版本現在附帶已簽署的 PowerShell 安裝程式。當環境中存在 PowerShell 7 模組路徑時，舊版透過 Windows PowerShell 安裝可能發生的壓縮檔校驗碼驗證失敗問題也已修好。下載管理方面，系統現在能防止舊版或預覽版本意外覆蓋較新的穩定版下載目標與安裝別名。⟦猶如官方包裹附上可核對來源的簽名，以前可能誤把舊包裹拿來替換新品，現在不會了。⟧
body.en: When installing or updating the system on Windows, installer scripts and version download mechanisms now offer higher security and compatibility. Windows releases now include a signed PowerShell installer. When PowerShell 7 module paths exist in the environment, archive checksum verification failures that previously occurred when installing through Windows PowerShell are now fixed. For download management, the system now prevents older or preview versions from accidentally overwriting newer stable download targets and installation aliases. ⟦Receiving an official package with a verifiable signature ensures that old parcels are no longer mistakenly used to replace brand-new items.⟧

items.original:
Fix archive checksum verification when installing through Windows PowerShell with PowerShell 7 module paths present. (#51257)
Publish a signed PowerShell installer with Windows releases. (#51158)
Keep older stable releases and prereleases from replacing newer stable download targets or installer aliases. (#51186, #51425)

title.zh-TW: Auto 模式登陸 Windows 11，加強沙盒外高風險指令審查
title.en: Auto Mode Arrives on Windows 11 with Stricter Out-of-Sandbox Command Review

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 11 24H2 或更新版本上使用個人 Google 帳戶時，現在你可以體驗能自行決定工具呼叫的 Auto 模式。⟦如同具備主動防護的車輛巡航系統，以前只照既定速限行駛而難以應對突發變換，現在遇到危險路況會主動放慢並要求駕駛接手確認。⟧你可以透過 `--mode auto` 參數、在 `/config` 設定選單的 Agent Mode 選取、按下快捷鍵 `Shift+Tab`，或是開啟 Remote Control 設定進行切換，預設選項仍維持為 Agent 模式。當 Auto 模式審查即將脫離終端機沙盒（sandbox，隔離指令執行的安全環境）的指令時，防護更為嚴謹。面對管線指令會逐一檢查其中的每個子指令；若是 `yes` 等簡短回覆，會連同助理的前一個提問一併納入評估，並在執行具破壞性的 Git 或檔案操作前主動跳出提示確認。
body.en: When running on Windows 11 24H2 or later with a personal Google account, you can now experience Auto mode, which decides tool calls on its own. ⟦Picture a car cruise control system with active safety: where it once only held a preset speed and struggled with sudden shifts, it now slows down on hazardous roads and prompts the driver to take over.⟧ You can switch modes via the `--mode auto` flag, by selecting Agent Mode in the `/config` settings menu, by pressing `Shift+Tab`, or by enabling Remote Control settings, while Agent mode remains the default. When Auto mode reviews commands about to leave the terminal sandbox (an isolated security environment for command execution), safeguards are significantly stricter. For pipeline commands, it inspects every sub-command individually; for short replies like `yes`, it evaluates them alongside the assistant's preceding question, prompting for confirmation before running destructive Git or file operations.

items.original:
Added Auto mode on Windows 11 version 24H2 and later for personal Google Accounts, selectable via `--mode auto`, `Agent Mode` in `/config`, `Shift+Tab`, or Remote Control Settings (`Agent` remains the default).
Improved Auto mode's review of commands that leave the terminal sandbox to include the assistant's preceding question on short replies like `yes`, check every subcommand in pipelines, and prompt before destructive Git or file commands.

title.zh-TW: /diff 支援區塊折疊與整檔切換，修正清單換行與標題截斷
title.en: /diff Adds Hunk Folding and Full File Toggle, Fixing List Wrapping and Title Truncation

body.zh-TW: 在終端機輸入 `/diff` 檢視程式碼變更時，Commit Tree 與 Per Turn 兩種檢視模式新增了多項閱讀控制。⟦跟查閱裝訂成冊的工程藍圖一樣，以前只能整頁攤開翻找細節，現在可以隨手折疊次要章節，還能把同一次施工的多處修改彙整在同一份清單。⟧現在按下快捷鍵 `f` 可以切換顯示整份檔案，按下 `Ctrl+O` 則能折疊個別變更區塊（hunk，版本控制中連續的一段程式碼修改）。在 Per Turn 檢視中，同一輪對話內對同一檔案進行的多次編輯，會直接合併為單一比對畫面，不再被拆得零散。清單顯示的排版問題也已修復，清單中超出終端機寬度的長行會正常截斷而不再強行折行，Per Turn 頂部標題也不會再把提示詞截斷在 50 個字元。
body.en: When typing `/diff` in the terminal to inspect code changes, Commit Tree and Per Turn views add several reading controls. ⟦Like consulting a bound set of engineering blueprints where you previously had to spread out entire pages to search for details, you can now collapse secondary sections at will and consolidate edits from the same job into a single list.⟧ Pressing `f` now toggles the full file view, while `Ctrl+O` folds an individual hunk (a contiguous section of code changes in version control). In Per Turn view, multiple edits made to the same file within a single turn merge directly into a unified diff screen instead of being scattered. List formatting issues are also fixed: lines exceeding terminal width now truncate cleanly rather than wrapping forcefully, and Per Turn headers no longer truncate prompts at 50 characters.

items.original:
Added whole-file toggle (`f`) and hunk folding (`Ctrl+O`) to `Commit Tree` and `Per Turn` views in `/diff`, and consolidated `Per Turn` diffs so multiple edits to a file in one turn appear as a single combined diff.
Fixed long rows wrapping instead of truncating at the terminal width in `/diff`'s `Commit Tree` and `Per Turn` lists, and `Per Turn` headers truncating prompts at 50 characters.

title.zh-TW: MCP 工具呼叫支援追溯最上層對話，清理伺服器連線洩漏
title.en: MCP Tool Calls Support Root Conversation Tracing, Fixing Server Connection Leaks

body.zh-TW: 當你使用 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）串接自訂伺服器時，子代理呼叫工具的追蹤能力有了重大改善。⟦就像委託跨國快遞寄件，以前轉交給各區投遞員後就查不到源頭，現在每筆派工紀錄都烙印總單號，無論轉發幾手都能追溯最初的寄件委託。⟧現在即使工具是由深層的巢狀子代理所觸發，發出的 `tools/call` 請求都會自動帶上 `_meta["antigravity.google/root_conversation_id"]` 欄位，讓外部伺服器能辨識最頂層的對話識別碼。在伺服器連線與資源釋放方面，先前若在伺服器啟動期間執行 `tools/list` 失敗，或是在連線尚未完成時直接關閉命令列工具，背景連線常式與用戶端工作階段容易殘留。這兩種情況造成的用戶端工作階段與背景連線常式洩漏，現在已修好。
body.en: When connecting custom servers with MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol that connects AI to external tools), tracking tool calls made by subagents is substantially improved. ⟦Think of shipping a package through an international courier: previously, handoffs to regional delivery agents obscured the origin, but now every dispatch record stamps a master tracking number so the initial request remains traceable across any number of transfers.⟧ Even when tools are invoked by deeply nested subagents, outgoing `tools/call` requests now automatically include the `_meta["antigravity.google/root_conversation_id"]` field so external servers can identify the top-level conversation ID. In terms of server connections and resource cleanup, background connection routines and client sessions previously lingered if `tools/list` failed during startup or if the CLI closed before the connection finished. Leaks of client sessions and background connection routines caused by both scenarios are now resolved.

items.original:
Added `_meta["antigravity.google/root_conversation_id"]` to MCP `tools/call` requests so MCP servers receive the top-level conversation ID even when a tool is called from a nested subagent.
Fixed MCP client sessions and background connection routines leaking when `tools/list` failed during server startup or when the CLI shut down while a server was connecting.

title.zh-TW: 外掛程式驗證加強嚴格檢查，修復子代理繼承與技能重複載入
title.en: Plugin Validation Enforces Stricter Checks, Fixing Subagent Inheritance and Skill Duplication

body.zh-TW:
在開發或安裝自訂擴充套件時，外掛程式的驗證機制與執行環境獲得了多項修正。

指令 `agy plugin validate` 導入更嚴格的檢查，全面檢驗 `plugin.json`、MCP 伺服器設定、`hooks.json` 與 sidecar 清單，防範無效 JSON 語法、未知欄位、錯誤變數佔位符、無法辨識的掛鉤（hook，事件觸發時執行的自動腳本）工具比對器及遺失腳本。

子代理方面，修復了子代理遺失父工作階段繼承外掛的問題；若打包外掛的子代理設定 `plugins.inherit_user: false` 且限制 MCP 工具，先前啟動拋出 `mcp spec not found for provider` 的異常也已修復。

當自訂規則或 `SKILL.md` 技能同時存在於獨立客製化資料夾與已啟用外掛程式時，系統不再重複載入兩次。
body.en:
When developing or installing custom extensions, plugin validation mechanisms and execution environments received multiple fixes.

The `agy plugin validate` command introduces stricter checks that thoroughly inspect `plugin.json`, MCP server configurations, `hooks.json`, and sidecar manifests, guarding against invalid JSON syntax, unknown fields, malformed variable placeholders, unrecognized tool matchers for hooks (automated scripts triggered by specific events), and missing scripts.

For subagents, an issue where subagents lost plugins inherited from parent sessions has been resolved. If a packaged plugin subagent sets `plugins.inherit_user: false` and restricts MCP tools, the startup error throwing `mcp spec not found for provider` is also fixed.

When custom rules or `SKILL.md` skills exist simultaneously in standalone customization folders and enabled plugins, the system no longer loads them twice.

items.original:
Improved `agy plugin validate` with stricter checks across `plugin.json`, MCP server configs, `hooks.json`, and sidecar manifests for invalid JSON syntax, unknown fields, bad variable placeholders, unrecognized hook tool matchers, and missing hook scripts.
Fixed subagents losing plugins inherited from the parent session, and fixed plugin-bundled subagents with `plugins.inherit_user: false` and restricted MCP tools failing to start with `mcp spec not found for provider`.
Fixed rules and `SKILL.md` skills loading twice when discovered from both a standalone customization folder and an enabled plugin.

title.zh-TW: 串流回應暫存降低資源消耗，壓縮請求保留工具宣告重用快取
title.en: Stream Response Caching Cuts Resource Overhead, Compaction Retains Tool Declarations

body.zh-TW: 當你請模型生成長篇回應或修改大量程式碼時，回應串流與對話壓縮的快取（cache，把處理過的結果暫存起來重複使用）機制減輕了運算負擔。⟦好比在料理檯旁備妥常備菜，已切洗好的食材直接下鍋而不重複動刀，收拾廚房時也把標準菜單留在黑板上，省去重新謄寫核對的時間。⟧在文字串流輸出期間，終端機現在會跨影格暫存程式碼區塊的語法標記（token，程式碼結構的分析記號）、算繪後的 Markdown 區塊，以及行內檔案編輯的確認比對畫面，降低 CPU 與記憶體使用量。而在執行 `/compact` 指令或系統觸發自動壓縮時，對話摘要請求會完整保留工具宣告，讓模型 API 能順暢重複使用先前已快取的提示詞前綴。
body.en: When asking models to generate lengthy responses or modify extensive code, caching mechanisms for response streaming and conversation compaction reduce computing overhead. ⟦Imagine keeping prepped ingredients ready by the kitchen counter, where washed and chopped items drop straight into the pot without re-cutting, while standard menus stay on the chalkboard during cleanup to save time re-copying.⟧ During streamed text output, the terminal now caches code-block syntax tokens (structural analysis units for code) across frames, along with rendered Markdown blocks and inline file edit confirmation diffs, lowering CPU and memory usage. When running `/compact` or when the system triggers automatic compaction, conversation summary requests preserve tool declarations intact, allowing model APIs to smoothly reuse previously cached prompt prefixes.

items.original:
Improved CPU and memory usage while streaming responses by caching streamed code-block syntax tokens, rendered Markdown blocks, and inline file-edit confirmation diffs across frames.
Improved `/compact` and automatic compaction to retain tool declarations on summarization requests so the model API reuses its cached prompt prefix.

title.zh-TW: Remote Control 支援平板多欄排版，修正行動端介面與算繪錯誤
title.en: Remote Control Adds Multi-Column Layout on Tablets, Fixing Mobile UI and Rendering Bugs

body.zh-TW:
在平板與行動裝置上使用 Remote Control 遠端控制時，大螢幕排版與多項操作體驗獲得整體升級。

平板與摺疊螢幕裝置不再強制縮成單欄手機畫面，而是啟用具備觸控尺寸控制項的多欄排版，拖曳捲軸時彈出的控制面板（popover）也會持續保持開啟。

行動端的介面細節也獲得修正。手機上標題與對話框遭截斷、iOS Safari 點選輸入框時畫面被自動放大、設定載入中 Enable Telemetry 與 Marketing Emails 開關自行跳回，以及拖曳網址時遺失查詢參數或井字標記（#）的問題已全數排除。

輸出算繪與檔案匯出同樣更為穩定。先前巢狀程式碼區塊排版破裂、帶錢字號的 Shell 變數（$VAR）被誤判為 LaTeX 公式、媒體預覽無法載入、複製圖片或匯出 PDF 時圖表模糊或空白，以及背景分頁計時器偏差等現象，現在都已修正完畢。
body.en:
When using Remote Control on tablets and mobile devices, large-screen layouts and various operational experiences received an overall upgrade.

Tablets and foldable devices are no longer forced into a single-column phone view; instead, they enable a multi-column layout with touch-sized controls, and popover panels remain open while dragging scrollbars.

Mobile interface details have also been refined. Issues where titles and dialogs truncated on phones, tapping input fields in iOS Safari triggered automatic zoom, the Enable Telemetry and Marketing Emails toggles flipped back while settings loaded, and dragging URLs lost query parameters or hashes (#) are all resolved.

Output rendering and file exports are likewise more stable. Prior issues with broken nested code block layouts, Shell variables ($VAR) being misidentified as LaTeX formulas, media previews failing to load, blurry or blank charts when copying images or exporting PDFs, and background tab timer drift have all been fixed.

items.original:
Improved Remote Control on tablets and foldables to use the multi-pane layout with touch-sized controls instead of collapsing to the phone view, and kept popovers open while dragging scrollbars.
Fixed several UI issues in Remote Control, including clipped headers and dialogs on phones, iOS Safari zoom on input focus, `Enable Telemetry` and `Marketing Emails` reverting while Settings loads, and dragged URLs losing query or `#` parameters.
Fixed rendering and export bugs in Remote Control, including broken nested code blocks, `$VAR` shell variables parsed as LaTeX, broken media previews, blurry or blank diagrams in `Copy Image` and `Export as PDF`, and background-tab timer drift.

title.zh-TW: 終端機輸入框回歸底部定位，修復 Ctrl+Z 復原與表情符號截斷
title.en: Terminal Input Box Re-Anchors to Bottom, Fixing Ctrl+Z Undo and Emoji Truncation

body.zh-TW: 在終端機中與模型對話時，輸入框的排版位置與文字復原行為迎來了重要修正。⟦正如在紙上書寫與擦拭草稿，以前橡皮擦常常擦掉多餘的字跡甚至弄縐紙張，現在每一次復原動作都能精準撤回上一筆紀錄。⟧先前當你關閉面板、下拉選單或行內提示時，輸入框有時會卡在螢幕中間不回彈，在 Medium 詳細度模式下輸入框上方還會出現空白縫隙；現在這些排版異常都已修復，輸入列會穩定貼齊底部。文字編輯方面，快捷鍵 Ctrl+Z 的復原機制已重新調整。過去貼上文字時復原容易錯亂，新輸入的內容甚至會與歷史紀錄錯誤合併。現在無作用的退格鍵與 Delete 不再被記錄為多餘步驟，在表情符號（emoji）旁執行刪除或復原時，也不會再發生字元遭到截斷的狀況。
body.en: When chatting with models in the terminal, the input box layout position and text undo behavior received major fixes. ⟦A writer sketching and erasing drafts on paper once risked smudging extra marks or wrinkling the sheet, but now each undo step accurately retracts the previous entry.⟧ Previously, closing panels, dropdown menus, or inline prompts could leave the input box stuck midway up the screen, and a blank gap appeared above the input box in Medium verbosity mode; these layout anomalies are now resolved, keeping the input bar securely anchored to the bottom. For text editing, the Ctrl+Z undo mechanism has been retuned. Pasting text previously scrambled undo history, sometimes incorrectly merging newly typed content with older history. Ineffective Backspace and Delete keystrokes are no longer recorded as extra steps, and deleting or undoing next to emojis (pictographic symbols) no longer causes characters to be truncated.

items.original:
Fixed the prompt box staying mid-screen after closing panels, dropdowns, or inline prompts, and blank gaps appearing above the prompt in `Medium` verbosity mode.
Fixed `Ctrl+Z` undo in the prompt mishandling pasted text, merging typing with recalled history entries, recording no-op `Backspace` or `Delete` steps, and truncating characters near emoji.

title.zh-TW: 修正規則優先順序措辭，明確涵蓋前方內建指示
title.en: Clarify Rule Precedence Phrasing to Explicitly Cover Earlier Built-In Instructions

body.zh-TW: 當你在專案根目錄撰寫自訂規範時，可以留意系統提示詞對規則優先順序的說明。以前系統提示詞（system prompt，引導 AI 行為的核心指示）的措辭，只寫出 GEMINI.md 與 AGENTS.md 的使用者規則可覆寫排在它們後方的指示。現在系統提示詞明確寫出 GEMINI.md 與 AGENTS.md 規則可覆寫較早出現的內建指示。
body.en: When writing custom rules in project roots, note the updated system prompt phrasing for rule precedence. Phrasing in the system prompt (core instructions guiding AI behavior) previously only stated that user rules in GEMINI.md and AGENTS.md could override instructions placed after them. The system prompt now explicitly clarifies that GEMINI.md and AGENTS.md rules can override earlier built-in instructions.

items.original: Fixed the system prompt's user rules wording so `GEMINI.md` and `AGENTS.md` rules explicitly override earlier built-in instructions instead of only instructions that follow them.

title.zh-TW: 支援帶編碼參數的媒體附件，避免音訊檔案遭錯誤拒絕
title.en: Support Media Attachments with Codec Parameters, Preventing Erroneous Audio Rejections

body.zh-TW: 當你在終端機對話中上傳音訊或多媒體檔案時，附件格式的相容性獲得了修正。以前若媒體附件的 MIME 類型（標示附件內容格式的類型名稱）帶有額外參數，例如常見的音訊格式 audio/webm; codecs=opus，會被誤判為不支援而直接遭到拒絕。這類原本受支援的附件，現在不會再因 MIME 類型帶有參數而被誤拒。
body.en: When uploading audio or multimedia files in terminal conversations, attachment format compatibility has been fixed. Previously, if a media attachment's MIME type (a label identifying attachment content formats) included extra parameters, such as the common audio format audio/webm; codecs=opus, it was incorrectly flagged as unsupported and rejected. Such natively supported attachments are no longer falsely rejected due to parameterized MIME types.

items.original: Fixed supported media attachments with parameterized MIME types such as `audio/webm; codecs=opus` being rejected as unsupported.

title.zh-TW: /diff 與產物檢視器新增搜尋功能，支援跨檔案逐筆跳轉
title.en: /diff and Artifact Viewer Add Search with Cross-File Match Navigation

body.zh-TW: 比對大批修改內容時，要在冗長的變更清單中精準定位某個函式或變數往往相當費時。在 `/diff` 的檔案清單與檔案檢視中，按下 `/` 即可啟動搜尋。輸入關鍵字時會即時反白相符字串，提示列還會列出整份差異比對與各檔案分別包含多少筆相符項目。按下 `Enter` 會跳到第一筆結果，接著按 `n` 或 `N` 就能跨檔案逐筆來回巡覽，頁首也會顯示如 `match A/B` 的進度指示。⟦尋訪長篇族譜名冊時，以前只能逐頁掃描而容易看漏同行的重複名字；現在輸入字根便立刻標記全冊，提示列載明各章節出現次數，還能依序巡禮每個相符人名。⟧在產物檢視器（artifact viewer，用來預覽生成文件的面板）中按 `n` 與 `N`，現在也會逐筆跳過同一行內的多個項目，不再整行跳躍。
body.en: When reviewing large sets of changes, pinpointing a specific function or variable across a lengthy change list is often time-consuming. In the file list and file view of `/diff`, pressing `/` starts a search. Typing keywords highlights matching strings in real time, while the prompt bar lists total matches across the diff and per file. Pressing `Enter` jumps to the first result, and pressing `n` or `N` navigates back and forth between matches across files, with the header showing progress indicators like `match A/B`. ⟦When searching through a lengthy genealogy registry, people previously had to scan page by page and easily missed duplicate names on the same line; now, typing a root immediately highlights the entire registry, with a prompt bar showing the number of occurrences per chapter, and lets you browse each matching name in sequence.⟧ In the artifact viewer (a panel used to preview generated documents), pressing `n` and `N` now also steps through multiple matches on the same line rather than skipping entire lines.

items.original: Added `/` search to the `/diff` file list and file view: matches are highlighted as you type, the search prompt shows how many matches the diff and each file contain, `Enter` jumps to the first match, and `n`/`N` step through matches one at a time across every file, with `match A/B` in the file view header. `n`/`N` in the artifact viewer now also step through matches one at a time, including several on the same line, instead of jumping from line to line.

title.zh-TW: 外掛驗證新增結構檢查，修正 Windows 覆寫防護與顏色輸出
title.en: Plugin Validation Adds Structural Checks, Fixing Windows Overwrite Protection and Color Output

body.zh-TW:
外掛設定疏漏或檔案被佔用以往容易導致異常。`agy plugin validate` 新增結構檢查：無法解析 `hooks.json`、`sidecar.json` 或元件清單時報錯；遇未知掛鉤、無效正規表達式（用符號比對字串）、未讀取的 `hooks/hooks.json`、遺漏路徑、不載入的 `commands/` 與 `workflows/` 或頂層 `"hooks"` 鍵名則警告。

在 Windows 更新或重裝外掛時，若被其他工作階段佔用，以前會留下半刪除毀損目錄；新版就位前舊版維持完整，替換失敗也會還原。

`agy plugin install` 與 `agy plugin import` 修正了導向輸出夾帶色碼的問題，現在只在終端機著色，並遵循 `NO_COLOR`、`CLICOLOR` 與 `CLICOLOR_FORCE`。
body.en:
Oversights in plugin configuration or occupied files previously caused errors. `agy plugin validate` adds structural checks, reporting errors if `hooks.json`, `sidecar.json`, or component manifests cannot be parsed. It warns on unknown hooks, unread `hooks/hooks.json`, missing paths, unloaded `commands/` and `workflows/`, or top-level `"hooks"` keys. It also warns on invalid regular expressions (patterns used to match strings).

When updating or reinstalling plugins on Windows, if files were locked by another session, a half-deleted corrupted directory was previously left behind. The old version now remains intact until the new version is in place, and rolls back if replacement fails.

`agy plugin install` and `agy plugin import` fix an issue where redirected output included color escape codes. Output is now colored only in the terminal, respecting `NO_COLOR`, `CLICOLOR`, and `CLICOLOR_FORCE`.

items.original:
Improved `agy plugin validate` to also check a plugin's hooks, sidecars, and component lists: it reports an error when `hooks.json`, a `sidecar.json`, or a `skills.json`, `rules.json`, `agents.json`, or `sidecars.json` file can't be parsed, and warns about unknown hook events, hook matchers that aren't valid regular expressions and so never match, a `hooks/hooks.json` file (which isn't read), list entries with no path or with a path missing from the plugin, `commands/` folders and `workflows/` Markdown files (which plugins don't load), and a Claude Code-style top-level `"hooks"` key, which loads as a single hook named `hooks`.
Fixed updating or reinstalling a marketplace plugin on Windows leaving it half-deleted when another `agy` session, the Antigravity desktop app, or the Remote Control background service had it open; the installed plugin now stays intact until the new copy is in place, and the previous version is restored if the replacement fails.
Fixed `agy plugin install` and `agy plugin import` writing color codes into piped or redirected output, ignoring `NO_COLOR`, and showing raw codes in older Windows consoles; like `agy plugin validate`, they now use color only in a terminal and follow `NO_COLOR`, `CLICOLOR`, and `CLICOLOR_FORCE`.

title.zh-TW: /tasks 計時器改以天時分秒顯示，清楚掌握剩餘時間
title.en: /tasks Timers Switch to Days, Hours, Minutes, and Seconds for Clearer Remaining Time

body.zh-TW: 當你在背景啟動了長時間排程，隨時掌握任務的等待時間是安排後續工作的關鍵。在終端機查看進行中的排程計時器時，時間標示方式直接影響你掌握進度的速度。在 `/tasks` 任務清單與作用中任務清單中，計時器標籤現在改以天、小時、分鐘與秒數來顯示時間長度，例如呈現為 `1d 2h timer` 或 `5m timer`。以前這裡只會顯示原始秒數，像是 `93784s timer`，讓人難以一眼看出到底還要等多久。⟦盯著大樓停車場的繳費機螢幕，以前停留時間只顯示幾萬秒讓人摸不著頭緒；現在直接換算成幾天幾小時幾分幾秒，一眼就能看清車輛停放了多久。⟧當你設定了排程任務時，只要在對話中輸入 `/tasks`，就能立刻從清單看到以天或分鐘標示的計時器，不必再自行拿計算機換算秒數。
body.en: When running long-running schedules in the background, keeping track of task waiting time is key to planning subsequent work. When checking active scheduled timers in the terminal, the time display format directly affects how quickly you grasp progress. In the `/tasks` task list and active tasks list, timer labels now display durations in days, hours, minutes, and seconds, appearing as `1d 2h timer` or `5m timer`. Previously, this displayed only raw seconds like `93784s timer`, making it hard to tell at a glance how much waiting time remained. ⟦Picture the screen of a parking payment machine, where parking duration previously showed only tens of thousands of seconds and left drivers baffled; now it directly converts into days, hours, minutes, and seconds, making it obvious at a glance how long a vehicle has been parked.⟧ When you configure scheduled tasks, simply typing `/tasks` in a conversation lets you immediately see timers labeled in days or minutes from the list, without needing a calculator to convert seconds yourself.

items.original: Improved timer labels in `/tasks` and the active task list to show durations in days, hours, minutes, and seconds, such as `1d 2h timer` or `5m timer`, instead of raw seconds such as `93784s timer`.

title.zh-TW: 修復以金鑰連線時未顯示 Gemini 4 Argon 的問題
title.en: Fix Missing Gemini 4 Argon When Connecting with an API Key

body.zh-TW: 習慣使用個人 API 金鑰切換模型時，可用清單若漏列特定選項會影響工作調度。當你透過環境變數 `GEMINI_API_KEY`（Gemini 服務的存取金鑰）連線時，先前在切換模型的 `/model` 指令選單以及 `--model` 啟動參數中，都沒有列出 Gemini 4 Argon 模型。現在這個問題已經修好，以金鑰連線時也能正常在選單與參數中指定該模型。
body.en: When you are accustomed to switching models using a personal API key, missing options from the available list disrupt workflow planning. When connecting through the `GEMINI_API_KEY` environment variable (the access key for Gemini services), the Gemini 4 Argon model was previously omitted from the `/model` command selection menu and the `--model` launch flag. This issue is now resolved, and you can properly select the model from the menu and specify it via the flag when connecting with an API key.

items.original: Fixed Gemini 4 Argon not shown in `/model` and `--model` when you connect with a `GEMINI_API_KEY`.

title.zh-TW: 不支援沙盒的作業系統不再列出終端機沙盒選項
title.en: Terminal Sandbox Options Omitted on Operating Systems Lacking Sandbox Support

body.zh-TW: 在不支援終端機沙盒（隔離執行指令的受限環境）的電腦上打開 CLI，本來就用不了的選項不該出現在選單裡。這類系統包括阻擋非特權使用者命名空間的 Linux 系統，以及 Windows 11 24H2 之前的舊版 Windows，以前命令列介面仍會提供需要沙盒支援的選項。這個問題已經修好，不支援沙盒的系統上不會再看到需要沙盒的選項。
body.en: When opening the CLI on a machine that does not support a terminal sandbox (a restricted environment that isolates command execution), unusable options should not appear in the menu. Such systems include Linux systems blocking unprivileged user namespaces and versions of Windows prior to Windows 11 24H2, where the command-line interface previously still offered options requiring sandbox support. This issue has been resolved, and systems without sandbox support will no longer display options requiring a sandbox.

items.original: Fixed the CLI offering options that need the terminal sandbox on systems where it can't run, such as Linux systems that block unprivileged user namespaces and Windows before Windows 11 24H2.

title.zh-TW: 自動模式子代理指令改由獨立代理審核，安全操作免手動核准
title.en: Auto-Mode Subagent Commands Reviewed by Independent Agent, Allowing Safe Operations Without Manual Approval

body.zh-TW: 讓代理在背景自動排解複雜任務時，頻繁跳出確認提示會打斷原本流暢的工作流程。在自動模式下，子代理（subagent，負責分流特定任務的輔助代理）與自訂代理以往只要執行脫離終端機沙盒的指令，每次都會停下來要求你手動核准。現在比照主代理的處理機制，它們的指令會先由另一個獨立代理負責審核。安全指令會直接執行，只有具備潛在風險的操作才會跳出提示向你確認。
body.en: When letting agents automatically handle complex tasks in the background, frequent confirmation prompts interrupt an otherwise smooth workflow. In auto mode, subagents (auxiliary agents that handle specific tasks) and custom agents previously paused to require manual approval every time they executed a command outside the terminal sandbox. Matching the behavior of the main agent, their commands are now reviewed first by an independent agent. Safe commands run directly, and only potentially risky operations prompt you for confirmation.

items.original: Fixed subagents and custom agents in Auto mode asking you to approve every command that would leave the terminal sandbox; like the main agent's, their commands are now first reviewed by a separate agent, so safe commands run without asking and risky ones still prompt you.

title.zh-TW: 對話壓縮保留子代理編號，精簡摘要不再丟失背景任務
title.en: Conversation Compaction Preserves Subagent IDs, Preventing Compacted Summaries from Losing Background Tasks

body.zh-TW: 長時間對話進行壓縮整理時，歷史任務資訊若被截斷，會讓代理遺忘先前派出的幫手。以前對話摘要會塞入每個子代理完整的初始提示詞，往往因為長度超限而在記錄對話編號（conversation ID）前就被截斷，導致代理失去對近期子代理的追蹤。現在壓縮摘要只保留各子代理的類型、角色與執行結果，確保識別資訊完整留存，並為語境視窗（context window，模型一次能讀取的記憶上限）留出更多空間。
body.en: When compacting and summarizing long conversations, truncated historical task information causes the agent to forget previously delegated helpers. Previously, conversation summaries included the full initial prompts for each subagent, which frequently exceeded length limits and were truncated before recording conversation IDs, causing the agent to lose track of recent subagents. Compacted summaries now retain only the type, role, and execution results of each subagent, ensuring identifiers are preserved while freeing up space for the context window (the maximum memory a model can read at one time).

items.original: Fixed the agent losing track of its most recently started subagents after a conversation was compacted, because the summary included each subagent's full initial prompt and was cut off before their conversation IDs; the summary now keeps only each subagent's type, role, and result, which also leaves more room in the context window.

title.zh-TW: PostToolUse 掛鉤失敗改為記錄日誌，不再將工具誤判為失敗
title.en: PostToolUse Hook Failures Now Logged Rather Than Misreporting Tool Failures

body.zh-TW: 設定工具執行的後續連動時，附加檢查腳本若發生異常，不應影響主要操作的成敗判定。在工具呼叫後觸發的 `PostToolUse` 掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）若執行失敗，例如指令不存在、執行逾時、退出回傳錯誤或輸出無效的 JSON，以前會將原本成功的工具呼叫直接標記為失敗。現在這類失敗只會記錄在日誌中，工具會完整保留原本的執行成果。
body.en: When configuring post-execution actions for tools, errors in supplemental check scripts should not affect the outcome of the primary operation. If `PostToolUse` hooks (small programs triggered when specific events occur) failed after a tool call—such as from a missing command, execution timeout, non-zero exit code, or invalid JSON output—the system previously marked an otherwise successful tool call as failed. Such failures are now recorded only in logs, leaving the original tool results fully intact.

items.original: Fixed a `PostToolUse` hook that fails to run, for example because its command is missing, exits with an error, times out, or prints invalid JSON, marking the tool call it follows as failed even though the tool succeeded; the failure is now logged and the tool keeps its result.

title.zh-TW: 修復空白檔案建立失敗，以及專案寫入誤報產物路徑的問題
title.en: Fix Empty File Creation Failures and Erroneous Artifact Path Errors on Project Writes

body.zh-TW: 讓代理建立新模組或初始化目錄時，建立標記檔案與修改專案內容是常見的操作。以前代理在建立如 `__init__.py` 或 `.gitkeep` 等空白檔案時會執行失敗，而且當模型送出空白的產物資訊時，寫入或編輯一般專案檔案也會跳出 `... is not a valid artifact path` 的報錯。現在這個問題已經修好，建立零內容檔案與正常編輯專案檔案都能順利完成。
body.en: When having an agent create new modules or initialize directories, generating marker files and modifying project contents are common operations. Previously, agents failed when creating empty files such as `__init__.py` or `.gitkeep`. In addition, writing or editing normal project files threw a `... is not a valid artifact path` error whenever the model sent blank artifact information. This issue is now resolved, allowing both zero-content file creation and standard project file editing to complete smoothly.

items.original: Fixed the agent failing to create empty files such as `__init__.py` or `.gitkeep`, and failing to write or edit regular project files with `... is not a valid artifact path` when the model sent blank artifact details.

title.zh-TW: iPhone 與 iPad 遠端控制支援狀態記憶，不再重複提示條款與通知
title.en: Remote Control on iPhone and iPad Adds State Persistence, Ending Repeated Terms and Notification Prompts

body.zh-TW: 在行動裝置上透過遠端功能查看進度時，每次開啟都必須手動關閉重複的提示視窗相當不便。在 iPhone 與 iPad 上使用 Remote Control（遠端控制功能）時，以前每次重新開啟，都會重複要求同意 `Security Notice & Data Use` 安全與資料使用條款，並再次彈出 `Enable Notifications` 啟用通知提示。現在應用程式會記住你的回覆，連同主題、排版設定以及已關閉的提示一併儲存。
body.en: When monitoring progress remotely on mobile devices, having to manually dismiss repetitive modal dialogs upon every launch is frustrating. When using Remote Control on iPhone and iPad, reopening previously prompted users to accept the `Security Notice & Data Use` terms again and popped up the `Enable Notifications` prompt each time. The application now remembers your responses, saving them alongside your theme, layout preferences, and dismissed prompts.

items.original: Fixed Remote Control on iPhone and iPad asking you to accept the `Security Notice & Data Use` terms and showing the `Enable Notifications` prompt again every time you reopened it; it now remembers your answers, along with your theme, layout, and dismissed tips.

title.zh-TW: 修復終端機游標錯位與換行，完善表情符號與多語字元排版
title.en: Fix terminal cursor misalignment and line wrapping, improving emoji and multilingual character layouts

body.zh-TW:
在終端機處理多國文字與圖示時，字寬計算誤差常導致游標跑位或排版錯亂。

調整視窗（停在 `↑ N more lines` 或框外）、提示過高、按上下鍵移至中日韓或表情符號，以及進入 Vim 視覺模式時游標不再錯位，過長的補全提示也會自動縮短。

在支援圖素叢集寬度的終端機中，從外部編輯器（`Ctrl+G`）或 `Ctrl+Z` 返回後及在 tmux 3.6+ 下，含 👩💻、👍🏽、⚠️ 的行不再漂移。在日中韓語系（如 `LANG=ja_JP.UTF-8`）下含 `→`、`…`、`─`、`•` 時的漂移與提早折行也一併修復。

按方向鍵、`Backspace` 或 `Delete` 不再只刪改半個表情符號、旗幟或變音字母，行末寬字元也會正確折行。在 `/diff` 與 `/artifact` 預覽中，結合符號或零寬字元導致提早折行、空白列或過早以 `…` 截斷也已修好。
body.en:
When handling multilingual text and symbols in the terminal, character width calculation errors often lead to cursor displacement or layout glitches.

The cursor no longer misaligns when resizing the window (resting on `↑ N more lines` or outside the frame), when prompts are excessively tall, when pressing Up or Down keys across CJK characters or emojis, or when entering Vim visual mode. Excessively long completion hints will also automatically shrink.

In terminals supporting grapheme cluster widths, lines containing 👩💻, 👍🏽, or ⚠️ no longer drift after returning from an external editor (`Ctrl+G`) or `Ctrl+Z`, or under tmux 3.6+. Drifting and premature line wraps when containing `→`, `…`, `─`, or `•` under CJK locales (such as `LANG=ja_JP.UTF-8`) have also been fixed.

Pressing arrow keys, `Backspace`, or `Delete` no longer modifies or deletes half of an emoji, flag, or accented letter, and wide characters at line ends now wrap correctly. In `/diff` and `/artifact` previews, premature line wrapping, blank lines, or early truncation with `…` caused by combining characters or zero-width characters have also been fixed.

items.original:
Fixed the prompt cursor appearing in the wrong place after resizing the terminal (sometimes on the `↑ N more lines` indicator or below the input box), when a slash command's completion hint didn't fit on the last line of the prompt (the hint is now shortened or left out), when the prompt was taller than the terminal, after pressing `Up` or `Down` onto a line with CJK characters or emoji, and after entering Vim visual mode, which also rewrapped the text.
Fixed the cursor drifting on lines with emoji such as 👩‍💻, 👍🏽, or ⚠️ inside tmux 3.6 and later, and after returning from your external editor (`Ctrl+G`) or a `Ctrl+Z` suspend in terminals that support grapheme-cluster widths.
Fixed the cursor drifting and lines wrapping too early under Japanese, Chinese, or Korean locales such as `LANG=ja_JP.UTF-8` when text contains characters like `→`, `…`, `─`, or `•`, which parts of the CLI counted as two columns wide while the rest drew them as one.
Fixed `Left`, `Right`, `Backspace`, and `Delete` in the prompt and other text boxes moving over or deleting only part of an emoji such as 👩‍💻 or 👍🏽, a flag, or a letter with a combining accent, and fixed text boxes cutting off a wide character, such as a CJK character or emoji, at the end of a wrapped line instead of moving it to the next line.
Fixed lines containing combining marks or other zero-width characters wrapping too early or leaving blank rows in `/diff` and the inline diff preview, and being cut off with `…` too soon in `/artifact` previews.

title.zh-TW: Remote Control 在 daemon 模式下能正常顯示對話紀錄
title.en: Remote Control Displays Conversation History Properly in Daemon Mode

body.zh-TW: 如果你習慣將工具以 daemon（在背景持續運作的服務）模式啟動，再透過 Remote Control 遠端操控介面查看進度，可能曾遇過找不到過去紀錄的狀況。以前在這種背景情境下，Remote Control 不會顯示先前的對話紀錄。現在這個問題已經修復，在 daemon 模式下對話紀錄會正常顯示。
body.en: If you usually launch the tool in daemon mode and check progress through the Remote Control interface, you might have run into cases where past records could not be found. Previously in these background scenarios, Remote Control did not display prior conversation history. This issue has now been fixed, and conversation history displays properly in daemon mode.

items.original: Fixed conversation history not showing in Remote Control in daemon mode.

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式等待背景工作接續對話，逾時中斷改回傳錯誤
title.en: Headless mode waits for background follow-up turns and exits with error on timeout

body.zh-TW: 當你寫腳本透過指令列自動處理任務時，最怕背景工作還沒做完程式就提早離場。使用 `grok -p` 啟動無頭模式（沒有終端機畫面的執行模式）時，若已完成的背景工作觸發了接續對話，現在會耐心等待該輪對話結束後才退出。⟦如同自助洗衣機的運轉流程，以前主行程一結束就立刻切斷電源，不管追加的防皺運轉跑完了沒有；現在機器會等接續動作徹底收尾才關機，要是設定的時間上限強行中斷了未完工項，面板更會亮起錯誤紅燈而不是回報順利完成。⟧如果加上 `--background-wait-timeout` 參數且因逾時停止了待處理工作，程式結束時會回傳錯誤代碼，不再誤報為成功執行。
body.en: When scripting automated tasks through the command line, the biggest risk is a process exiting prematurely before background work finishes. When launching headless mode (an execution mode with no terminal screen) with `grok -p`, if completed background tasks trigger follow-up conversation turns, the runner now waits patiently for that turn to conclude before exiting. ⟦Like the cycle of a laundromat washing machine, the power previously cut off the moment the main cycle finished, regardless of whether the extra anti-wrinkle cycle had completed; now the machine shuts down only after follow-up actions wrap up completely, and if a configured time limit forcibly stops unfinished work, the panel flashes a red error light instead of reporting a successful run.⟧ If you provide the `--background-wait-timeout` option and pending work is stopped due to a timeout, the program now exits with an error code instead of falsely reporting success.

items.original: Headless mode (`grok -p`) waits for the follow-up turn that a finished background task starts before exiting, and a `--background-wait-timeout` that stops pending work exits with an error instead of success

title.zh-TW: 儀表板冷啟動恢復工作階段，保持浮層開啟並支援按鍵返回
title.en: Dashboard cold boot resumes sessions while keeping popover open with keyboard back navigation

body.zh-TW: 你在儀表板翻找過去的歷史紀錄時，可能會想先點進某個舊存檔看看進度。在儀表板浮層中針對未預載的存檔執行冷啟動 `/resume` 時，介面現在會讓浮動面板保持附著開啟。⟦彷彿在電子導覽機前點選歷史路徑，以前只要觸控未預載的深層檔案，選單面板就會冷不防關閉脫離，讓人想反悔返回都無從按起；現在清單畫面會持續固定在視野中，隨時都能按上一頁安全退回。⟧如此一來，載入舊工作階段時不會丟失操作畫面，你可以隨時按下向左方向鍵（Left）或 `Ctrl+\` 順利退出，返回原本的清單繼續瀏覽。
body.en: When browsing past history in the dashboard, you might want to open an older saved state to inspect its progress. Triggering a cold `/resume` on an unloaded session from the dashboard popover now keeps the floating panel open and attached. ⟦At a digital directory kiosk, tapping an unloaded deep record previously caused the menu panel to snap shut and detach unexpectedly, leaving no way to step back; now the list display stays anchored in view so you can safely return at any moment.⟧ This way, you never lose your context when loading an older session, and you can press the Left arrow key (Left) or `Ctrl+\` at any time to exit cleanly and return to the list.

items.original: Cold `/resume` from the dashboard overlay keeps the overlay attached, so you can still back out with Left or `Ctrl+\`

title.zh-TW: 選取帶參數斜線指令按 Enter 直接執行，不再殘留空格
title.en: Selecting slash commands with arguments and pressing Enter executes immediately without trailing spaces

body.zh-TW: 在終端機輸入框使用斜線指令時，大家常會透過選單挑選想跑的動作。當你在提示詞撰寫區反白選取帶有可選參數的斜線指令並按下 Enter 鍵時，現在會立刻執行該指令。以前輸入框（composer，撰寫提示詞的文字區）只會在指令後面留下一格多餘的空格，停在原地等待你再次確認。⟦好比在車載導航螢幕上選取附帶途經點的路線，以前按下確認鈕，畫面只會在輸入欄末端留下一格空白等候；現在一按便直接開始指引，不再卡在輸入框等待多餘的操作。⟧這樣不必在選好指令後還得手動多敲一次鍵，命令一選定就能順暢送出。
body.en: When using slash commands in the terminal input box, users often pick actions from the menu. Selecting a slash command with optional arguments in the prompt area and pressing Enter now executes that command immediately. Previously, the composer (the text area for writing prompts) only appended an extra space after the command, sitting idle while waiting for your confirmation. ⟦On an in-car navigation screen, selecting a route with waypoints and hitting confirm previously only left a blank space at the end of the input field; now a single press starts guidance immediately instead of stalling for redundant input.⟧ You no longer need to press an extra key manually after choosing a command, allowing selected actions to submit smoothly.

items.original: Enter on a highlighted slash command with optional arguments runs the command instead of leaving a trailing space in the composer

title.zh-TW: 多項 CLI 指令支援管道提早關閉與串流限制，避免輸出異常崩潰
title.en: Multiple CLI commands handle early pipe closures and stream limits without crashing

body.zh-TW: 平時在終端機串接多道指令過濾資料時，下游工具提早結束往往會引發非預期的中斷。包含 `grok models`、列出工作階段的 `grok sessions` 與 `grok export` 等指令，當輸出管道提早關閉（例如串接 `head` 只取前幾行）或輸出裝置已滿時，現在都不再發生當機。⟦就像工廠輸送帶上的分裝包裝線，以前只要下游集貨箱裝滿或接收閘門提早關閉，傳送機械便會當場卡死並引發整條產線警報；現在機台一旦察覺出口無法收件，就會平順停止輸出並安穩關機。⟧`grok update` 與 `grok login` 兩項指令在標準輸出（stdout）或標準錯誤關閉且無法寫入時，現在同樣能安全結束，確保批次腳本不再因串流截斷而崩潰。
body.en: When piping multiple commands in the terminal to filter data, a downstream tool exiting early often triggers unexpected disruptions. Commands including `grok models`, `grok sessions` for listing sessions, and `grok export` no longer crash when their output pipe closes early (such as when piped into `head` for the first few lines) or when the output device fills up. ⟦In a factory conveyor packaging line, if a downstream collection bin filled up or a receiving gate closed early, the transport machinery previously jammed on the spot and triggered plant-wide alarms; now the equipment halts output smoothly and shuts down safely as soon as it detects that the exit cannot accept packages.⟧ `grok update` and `grok login` now also exit safely when standard output (stdout) or standard error is closed and unwritable, ensuring batch scripts no longer crash due to truncated streams.

items.original:
CLI commands such as `grok models`, `grok sessions` and `grok export` no longer crash when their output pipe closes early, such as when piped to `head`, or when the output device is full
`grok update` and `grok login` no longer crash when stdout or stderr is closed or unwritable

title.zh-TW: /resume 精確比對單一工作階段直接開啟，選單支援任意詞序搜尋
title.en: /resume Directly Resumes an Exact Single-Session Match and Supports Any-Word-Order Search in the Picker

body.zh-TW: 當你累積了大量對話紀錄想重新接續進度時，不必再忍受死板的關鍵字順序或多餘的確認步驟。⟦翻找辦公室抽屜裡的專案夾時，以前封面標題上的單字順序只要顛倒就翻不出來，就算報出唯一編號也非得拉開整個清單；現在只要寫齊關鍵字無論順序都能對應，代碼剛好只吻合一份時更能直接抽取出夾。⟧現在在終端機輸入 `/resume <id or name>` 時，只要指定的 ID 或標題剛好只吻合單一工作階段，Grok Build 就會直接進入該工作階段，不再每次都強制彈出挑選器讓你多點一次。如果呼叫挑選器手動尋找，只要輸入的內容包含標題中的每一個單字，無論先後順序為何，挑選器都能精確列出符合的工作階段。
body.en: When you have accumulated a large conversation history and want to resume progress, you no longer have to endure rigid keyword ordering or redundant confirmation steps. ⟦Picture someone searching for a project folder in an office drawer. Previously, if the word order on the cover was reversed, it could not be found, and reciting a unique number still required opening the entire list. Now, entering all keywords matches regardless of sequence, and matching exactly one code lets you pull the folder straight out.⟧ Now when you enter `/resume <id or name>` in the terminal, as long as the specified ID or title matches exactly one session, Grok Build directly enters that session instead of forcing a picker popup every time for an extra click. If you bring up the picker to search manually, the picker accurately lists matching sessions as long as your input includes every word in the title, regardless of their order.

items.original:
Resume picker finds sessions whose titles contain every word you type, in any order
`/resume <id or name>` opens the session directly when the ID or title matches exactly one session, instead of always opening the picker

title.zh-TW: 儀表板預覽文字支援滑鼠拖曳，放開即自動複製到剪貼簿
title.en: Dashboard Preview Text Supports Mouse Dragging, Automatically Copying to the Clipboard on Release

body.zh-TW: 想要從儀表板快速擷取一段預覽內容轉貼給同事時，現在不需要再按任何鍵盤快捷鍵。⟦拿著螢光筆在文件上劃記重點時，以前畫完標記還得手動按相機快門留底；現在筆尖劃過文字並在放開筆桿時，內容就自動傳送至隨身筆記。⟧在儀表板檢視預覽文字時，你可以直接按住滑鼠游標拖曳選取想要的字串。只要在選取完成後放開滑鼠按鍵，被標記的文字片段就會自動複製到剪貼簿。無論是需要摘錄報錯內容還是比對執行結果，拖曳選取後就能直接切換到其他對話視窗貼上，省下反白後還要按鍵複製的瑣碎手續。
body.en: When you want to quickly grab preview content from the dashboard to paste for a colleague, you no longer need to press any keyboard shortcuts. ⟦Imagine marking highlights on a document with a highlighter. Previously, after finishing the mark, you still had to press a camera shutter manually to keep a record; now, as the pen tip glides across the text and releases, the content is transmitted automatically to a pocket notebook.⟧ While viewing preview text on the dashboard, you can click and drag the mouse cursor to select the desired string. As soon as you release the mouse button after completing the selection, the marked text snippet is automatically copied to the clipboard. Whether you need to extract error details or compare execution results, you can paste directly into another chat window right after dragging to select, saving the tedious step of pressing keys to copy after highlighting.

items.original: Dashboard peek text can be selected by dragging over it with the mouse, and the selection is copied to the clipboard when you release

title.zh-TW: 工作流程檢視向下滾動名冊時，畫面持續朝較新代理人平順推進
title.en: Workflow View Smoothly Advances Toward Newer Agents When Scrolling Down the Roster

body.zh-TW: 追蹤多個代理人協同運作的工作流程時，檢視進度最怕視窗畫面不聽使喚。⟦順著排隊走道向前推動檢視鏡頭時，以前只要滾輪往下滾動，視野就冷不防被彈簧拉回起點；現在畫面會依循操作，順暢朝著後方新加入的成員推進。⟧在工作流程的執行檢視畫面中，當你在代理人名冊上向下滾動滑鼠滾輪時，畫面現在會順著操作方向持續朝向較新的代理人捲動，而不是突然彈回原處。這讓你在依序盤點每個代理人的最新執行進度時，視野能夠一路平穩跟隨，不必反覆重新尋找焦點。
body.en: When tracking a workflow where multiple agents collaborate, the biggest frustration when checking progress is an uncooperative viewport. ⟦Think of tracking an inspection camera forward along a queue corridor. Previously, whenever the scroll wheel moved downward, the view was abruptly pulled back to the starting point like a spring; now, the frame follows the action, smoothly advancing toward newly joined members at the rear.⟧ In the workflow execution view, when you scroll down on the agent roster with the mouse wheel, the view now continuously scrolls toward newer agents in the direction of your movement, rather than snapping back to the origin. This allows your line of sight to smoothly follow along as you inspect each agent's latest execution progress in sequence, without having to repeatedly hunt for focus.

items.original: Workflow run views scroll toward newer agents when you wheel down the agent roster, instead of snapping back

title.zh-TW: Windows 執行掛鉤失敗時點名未啟動的程式，不再誤指指令碼出錯
title.en: Windows Identifies Unstarted Programs When Hook Execution Fails, Rather Than Blaming the Script

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 環境下使用掛鉤（在特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）除錯自動化流程時，最怕看到語意模糊的錯誤訊息。⟦呼叫外勤車隊出門執行任務時，以前只要外包貨車在門口無法發動，控制台卻只會回報派工單寫錯；現在通報會明確點名是哪一輛車發動失敗，不再冤枉原本寫好的任務清單。⟧在 Windows 系統中若掛鉤產生行程失敗，終端機現在會直接點名究竟是哪個外部程式無法啟動，例如具體標示出 PowerShell 或 Git Bash 發生錯誤，而不是怪罪掛鉤指令稿本身。面對這類問題時，你能立刻看出是環境缺少執行工具還是路徑設定遺漏，省下逐行檢查指令碼內容的時間。
body.en: When debugging automated workflows on Windows using hooks (small programs triggered by specific events), the worst experience is seeing ambiguous error messages. ⟦Dispatching a field fleet for a mission previously meant that whenever an outsourced truck failed to start at the gate, the control center only reported an error in the work order; now, the alert clearly names which vehicle failed to start without falsely blaming the original task list.⟧ If a hook fails to spawn a process on Windows, the terminal now directly names which external program failed to start, such as specifically indicating an error in PowerShell or Git Bash, rather than blaming the hook script itself. When confronting such issues, you can immediately tell whether the environment lacks an execution tool or is missing a path configuration, saving time spent inspecting the script line by line.

items.original: Hook spawn failures on Windows name the program that failed to start, such as PowerShell or Git Bash, instead of blaming the hook script

title.zh-TW: grok --resume 依更新時間排序工作階段，找不到本機紀錄時即刻回報
title.en: grok --resume sorts sessions by update time and immediately reports when local records are missing

body.zh-TW:
當你累積了大量對話想重新接續先前的工作進度，只憑模糊印象輸入名稱往往難以精準定位。⟦如同在圖書館櫃檯查詢借閱紀錄，以前一旦館內找不到藏書，館方電腦便主動發起外館調閱並要求重新刷卡驗證；現在螢幕直接按最後更新時間由近到遠條列項目，若沒有相符紀錄還會提示相近名稱，找不到時立即告知結果。⟧

執行 `grok --resume <title>` 恢復對話時，列出的相符工作階段會依據最後更新時間由新到舊排序，並清楚附上各自的最近更新時間。要是輸入的名稱完全沒有符合的紀錄，命令列會主動推薦相似的標題供你挑選。

當指定的標題在本地電腦中完全不存在時，命令列現在會立即回報未找到，而不是嘗試發起遠端還原程序並要求你登入帳號。
body.en:
When you have accumulated many conversations and want to resume earlier progress, typing a name from vague memory often makes precise targeting difficult. ⟦Think of checking borrowing records at a library counter. Previously, whenever a book was missing from the collection, the computer initiated an interlibrary loan and required card reverification; now, the screen lists items from newest to oldest by last update time, suggests similar names if no record matches, and reports the result immediately when nothing is found.⟧

When running `grok --resume <title>` to resume a conversation, matching sessions are listed in order from newest to oldest based on their last update time, clearly displaying their respective recent update times. If the entered name has no matching records at all, the command line recommends similar titles for you to choose from.

When the specified title does not exist at all on the local machine, the command line now immediately reports that it was not found, instead of attempting to initiate a remote restore process and asking you to log in.

items.original:
`grok --resume <title>` lists matching sessions newest first with when each was last updated, and suggests similar titles when nothing matches
`grok --resume <title>` with a title that matches no local session reports the miss right away instead of trying a remote restore and asking you to sign in

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕 Markdown 檢視器按 Shift+Y 複製游標所在的程式碼區塊
title.en: Full-screen Markdown viewer copies the code block under the cursor with Shift+Y

body.zh-TW:
閱讀長篇技術文件或檢視終端機輸出時，切換到全螢幕檢視器能讓排版更為乾淨，但想取用其中的範例段落往往需要額外步驟。⟦彷彿拿著手持掃描器在貨架間盤點，以前想記錄規格得拿出紙筆沿著邊界逐字謄寫，現在光點只要對準商品標籤扣下按鍵，整組資料便立刻收進隨身清單。⟧

在全螢幕 Markdown 檢視器中，現在只要將游標移動到目標程式碼上方，按下快捷鍵 `Shift+Y`，就會複製游標所在的整個程式碼區塊。如此一來，閱讀長篇文件時便能直接擷取所需的指令或程式碼片段，不必再特地動用滑鼠手動框選。
body.en:
When reading long technical documents or inspecting terminal output, switching to a full-screen viewer keeps the layout cleaner, but grabbing example passages often takes extra steps. ⟦Picture taking inventory among store shelves with a handheld scanner. Previously, recording specifications meant pulling out pen and paper to transcribe character by character along the margins; now, aiming the light beam at a product label and pressing a button instantly pulls the whole dataset into a portable list.⟧

In the full-screen Markdown viewer, moving the cursor over target code and pressing `Shift+Y` now copies the entire code block beneath the cursor. Reading long documents this way lets you capture needed commands or snippets directly without reaching for a mouse to highlight them manually.

items.original: `Shift+Y` in the fullscreen markdown viewer copies the code block under the cursor

title.zh-TW: 從儀表板開啟工作階段時，按 Esc 聚焦回捲歷程而非退回儀表板
title.en: Pressing Esc focuses scrollback instead of returning to dashboard when opening a session

body.zh-TW:
從儀表板開啟特定工作階段準備輸入指令時，要是想先檢閱先前的上下文，直覺按鍵往往可能帶來非預期的畫面切換。⟦跟參觀特展展示台一樣，以前在互動導覽的第一道題目按下返回鍵，畫面會冷不防退回接待大廳；現在只會把檢視游標移到上方的過往解說板，與獨立參觀時的行為完全相同。⟧

以前從儀表板開啟工作階段後，若在第一個提問處按下 `Esc`，畫面會直接關閉並退回儀表板。現在按下 `Esc` 時，焦點會切換到上方儲存的回捲歷程（scrollback，可往上捲動查看歷史輸出的區域）。這樣的一致行為與直接在終端機啟動的獨立工作階段相同，避免你為了查看先前的對話而中斷手頭上的流程。
body.en:
When opening a session from the dashboard to enter commands, intuitive keystrokes can often trigger unexpected view switches if you want to inspect earlier context first. ⟦Like visiting a special exhibition booth, pressing back at the first question of an interactive guide used to kick you back to the reception hall without warning; now, it only shifts the viewing cursor up to the previous display board, behaving exactly like a self-guided tour.⟧

Previously, after opening a session from the dashboard, pressing `Esc` at the first prompt would close the view and return directly to the dashboard. Now, pressing `Esc` shifts focus to the saved scrollback (the buffer area for scrolling up to inspect past output). This consistent behavior matches standalone sessions started directly in the terminal, preventing interruptions to your workflow when you only want to review prior dialogue.

items.original: `Esc` on the first question in a session opened from the dashboard moves focus to the scrollback, as it does in a standalone session, instead of returning to the dashboard

title.zh-TW: /blender 指令登場，參考圖直接重建為 3D 可編輯場景
title.en: /blender Command Debuts to Reconstruct Reference Images Directly into Editable 3D Scenes

body.zh-TW: 當你手邊有一張概念設計圖或參考照片，想快速建立立體模型時，往往需要在建模程式裡從零搭建物件與燈光。新推出的 `/blender` 指令能依據參考圖片，自動重建出可自由編輯的 Blender（一套開源三維繪圖工具）場景。⟦就像拿著一張平面設計草圖走進工作室，模型師當場組裝出能拆卸零件、隨意更換視角的立體模型。⟧這讓你省去繁瑣的手動對位，產出的檔案也能立刻在編輯器內接續調整視角、材質與燈光。
body.en:
When you have a concept design sketch or reference photo and want to quickly create a 3D model, you often need to build objects and lighting from scratch in modeling software. The newly introduced `/blender` command automatically reconstructs a freely editable Blender (an open-source 3D modeling tool) scene based on reference images.

⟦Picture walking into a studio with a 2D design sketch, where a modeler immediately assembles a 3D model with detachable parts and freely adjustable viewing angles on the spot.⟧

This saves you from tedious manual alignment, and the generated files can immediately be used to adjust perspectives, materials, and lighting directly in the editor.

items.original: Added `/blender` to reconstruct reference images as editable Blender scenes

title.zh-TW: 電腦操作精簡工具呼叫，跳過重複查閱與多餘清單直奔目標
title.en: Computer Use Streamlines Tool Calls, Skipping Redundant Checks and Lists to Head Straight for Goals

body.zh-TW: 讓 AI 代理操作桌面螢幕時，每多呼叫一次工具，都會拉長等待時間並消耗額度。電腦操作（Computer Use，讓 AI 透過視覺畫面模擬人類點擊與輸入的機制）現在減少了許多冗餘的工具呼叫。當任務明確指定某個應用程式時，它會直接啟動該程式，不再先列出所有應用程式清單；遇到檔案或系統查詢，會直接以終端機指令回答；它還會跳過重複閱讀自身說明的動作。⟦好比熟練的助理接獲指令便立刻動手，不再反覆翻閱員工手冊或把工具箱裡的物件逐一清點一遍。⟧就算畫面當下看起來像是已經做完，它仍會依照指示確實執行任務。
body.en:
When having an AI agent operate desktop screens, every extra tool call prolongs waiting times and consumes quota. Computer Use (a mechanism that lets AI simulate human clicks and keystrokes through visual screens) now cuts out many redundant tool calls. When a task explicitly specifies an application, it launches that program directly instead of first listing all applications. When encountering file or system queries, it answers directly with terminal commands. It also skips repeatedly re-reading its own instructions.

⟦Think of a skilled assistant getting straight to work upon receiving an order, instead of repeatedly leafing through the employee handbook or counting every item in the toolbox.⟧

Even if the screen currently looks like the task is already finished, it still carries out the assignment faithfully according to instructions.

items.original: Computer Use makes fewer tool calls: it skips re-reading its own instructions, opens the app a task clearly points to without listing apps first, answers file and system questions with the shell, and does the task even when the screen already looks done

title.zh-TW: 背景任務提示頻率降至單次，監聽狀態即刻顯示且長程目標不中斷
title.en: Background Task Prompts Reduced to Once, Displaying Listening States Instantly Without Halting Goal Runs

body.zh-TW: 在終端機啟動耗時較長的工作時，對話視窗的提示頻率與狀態顯示有了更清晰的安排。執行超過 30 分鐘的背景指令，現在只會主動提示代理一次，不再每隔半小時就提醒，需要時由代理自行排定後續檢查時機。當代理收到長時間背景指令的提示時，對話紀錄會顯示「Waiting for background task」，讓你明白它為何開始動作；針對仍在執行的背景指令，重複發出的等待請求也不再卡住整個等待時間。即使電腦負載偏高或硬碟緩慢，新啟動的監聽器也會即刻出現在頁尾與 `/tasks` 清單中。在長程目標模式（goal run，讓 AI 自主推進多步驟目標的執行流程）下，若工具執行後產生了新的下一步指引，它會替換既有指引並繼續前進，不再提早停下；僅在指引完全相同時才會如常停止。
body.en: When launching long-running jobs in the terminal, prompt frequencies and status displays in conversation windows are now arranged much more clearly. Background commands running longer than 30 minutes will now proactively prompt the agent only once instead of reminding it every half hour, leaving the agent to schedule follow-up checks when needed. When an agent receives a prompt for a long-running background command, the conversation log displays "Waiting for background task" so you understand why it started taking action. Repeated wait requests for background commands that are still executing no longer stall the entire wait duration. Even under heavy machine load or slow disk speeds, newly started listeners appear immediately in the footer and the `/tasks` list. In goal run mode (an execution flow where AI autonomously advances multi-step goals), if a tool run produces new next-step guidance, it replaces existing guidance and continues moving forward rather than stopping early. It only stops as usual when the guidance is completely identical.

items.original:
A background command that runs past 30 minutes now prompts the agent once instead of every 30 minutes; the agent schedules its own later check if it needs one
The transcript shows "Waiting for background task" when the agent is prompted about a long-running background command, so you can see why it started working
A duplicate wait for a background command that is still running no longer holds the chat for its full requested wait
A monitor you start now appears in the footer and in `/tasks` right away, even when the machine is busy or the disk is slow
A long goal run no longer stops early when fresh next-step guidance replaces still-active guidance after new tool work; identical guidance still stops as before

title.zh-TW: 沙盒環境嚴格隔離設定目錄，Git 技能禁止擅自隱藏未追蹤檔案
title.en: Sandbox Environment Strictly Isolates Config Directories, Forbidding Git Skill from Hiding Untracked Files

body.zh-TW: 把終端機指令交給 AI 時，機密資料與檔案庫的安全界線至關重要。沙盒（sandbox，隔離執行的受限環境）指令，無法再讀取或修改 `~/.config/muse`、`~/.config/tbh` 或 `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` 下的登入資訊、設定、核准規則與被封鎖程式。任務只要求乾淨工作樹時，Git 技能拒絕用忽略規則或 stash 隱藏未追蹤檔案。掛鉤（hook，特定事件觸發的小程式）參數 `model_provider` 改標註模型供應商；僅 Meta 閘道列為 Meta 擁有的模型回報 `meta`，其餘省略，其上的 Claude 或 GPT 工作階段不再回報為 `meta`。⟦像訪客證開不了保險櫃，清潔工也不准把雜物塞進抽屜掩蓋混亂。⟧
body.en:
When delegating terminal commands to AI, the security boundaries of sensitive credentials and repositories are critical. Sandboxed commands (a restricted environment for isolated execution) can no longer read or modify login credentials, settings, approval rules, or blocked applications under `~/.config/muse`, `~/.config/tbh`, or `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`. When a task only requires a clean worktree, the Git skill refuses to hide untracked files using ignore rules or stash. The hook (a small program triggered by a specific event) parameter `model_provider` now indicates the model provider. Only models listed as Meta-owned by the Meta gateway report `meta`, while others omit it, so Claude or GPT sessions running on it no longer report `meta`.

⟦Just as a visitor badge cannot open a safe, a cleaner is also forbidden to shove clutter into drawers to hide a mess.⟧

items.original:
Security: Sandboxed commands can no longer read or change sign-in details, settings, approval rules or blocked apps stored in `~/.config/muse`, `~/.config/tbh` or the same folders under `XDG_CONFIG_HOME`
Security: The git skill now refuses to hide your untracked files with ignore rules or a stash when a task only asks for a clean tree
Security: Hook input `model_provider` now names the vendor of the selected model instead of the connection it was routed through: it is `meta` only for a model the built-in Meta gateway catalog lists as Meta-owned, and is omitted otherwise, so a Claude or GPT session on the Meta gateway no longer reports `meta`

title.zh-TW: 工作流程子任務獨立重試，崩潰重啟精準標記中斷狀態
title.en: Workflow Subtasks Retry Independently, Accurately Tagging Interrupted States upon Crash Restarts

body.zh-TW: 執行包含多個子任務的工作流程時，單一環節發生中斷不再導致整個流程無故卡死。如果工作流程（Workflow，串聯多個子任務自動化執行的機制）的子任務因啟動紀錄無法儲存，或該任務已存有另一筆不同的啟動紀錄而停止，現在會以白話說明未執行任何新操作、其餘子任務仍持續運作，並指引下一步做法。排定重試後立刻遭中斷的任務，恢復時會依照原記錄的模型與思考力度接續運作。若恢復的任務初次儲存在任何內容寫入前就失敗，僅有該任務會重試而非中斷整個流程；重試的儲存再失敗，也僅標記該任務失敗，並告訴你下一步該怎麼做。遇崩潰重新啟動時，若已終止的代理重啟遭拒，其紀錄列會直接標為失敗並讓整體流程完工，不再誤顯為執行中。
body.en: When executing workflows containing multiple subtasks, an interruption in a single step no longer stalls the entire flow without explanation. If a subtask in a workflow (a mechanism that chains multiple subtasks for automated execution) stops because its launch record cannot be saved, or because a different launch record already exists for it, it now explains in plain language that no new operations were run, confirms that other subtasks are still running, and guides next steps. Tasks interrupted immediately after scheduling a retry will resume operation using the originally recorded model and reasoning effort. If an initial save of a resumed task fails before any content is written, only that task retries instead of interrupting the entire workflow. If the retried save fails again, it only marks that task as failed and tells you what to do next. Upon restarting after a crash, if a terminated agent is rejected for restart, its record row is directly marked as failed and allows the overall workflow to finish, rather than mistakenly displaying as running.

items.original:
A Workflow child that stops because its start record can't be saved, or because a different start record was already saved for it, now says in plain words that nothing new ran, that the other Workflow children keep running, and what to do next
A Workflow task that was interrupted right after it scheduled a retry now resumes with its recorded model and effort instead of being held
When a resumed Workflow task's first save fails before anything is written, only that task retries instead of the whole Workflow stopping; if the retry's save fails too, only that task fails and tells you what to do next
A Workflow resumed after a crash no longer shows a killed agent as still running when its relaunch is refused before it starts; the killed attempt's row now ends Failed and the Workflow completes

title.zh-TW: 工作流程恢復後保留自訂名稱，控制台與即時進度完整顯示
title.en: Workflows Retain Custom Names After Resuming, Displaying Fully in Console and Live Progress

body.zh-TW: 為工作流程取了清楚好記的專屬名稱，卻常在重新啟動或查閱紀錄時被打回預設代號。現在工作流程中途暫停並重新恢復後，各項流程訊息與結束提示都會完整保留先前記錄的自訂名稱。控制室面板以及點開的執行結果頁面，也會持續顯示該流程原本的名稱。新儲存的流程歷史紀錄與即時動態更新都會採用所記錄的名稱；如果遇上過去未儲存名稱的舊版執行紀錄，介面則會明確標記為「name unavailable」，方便你清楚辨識。⟦跟在專案檔案夾貼上手寫標籤一樣，中途交接給其他班次時，標籤依然牢牢貼在封面，不再因為換人接手就退回空白編號。⟧
body.en:
Giving a workflow a clear and memorable custom name often used to result in it reverting to a default identifier upon restarting or checking records. Now, after a workflow is paused mid-run and resumed, workflow messages and finish prompts fully retain the previously recorded custom name. The Mission Control panel and opened run result pages also consistently display the workflow's original name. Newly saved workflow history records and real-time live updates will use the recorded name. If encountering legacy execution records where names were not previously saved, the interface clearly marks them as "name unavailable" for easy identification.

⟦Much like a handwritten label taped to a project folder stays firmly on the cover during a handover to another shift, it no longer reverts to a blank number just because someone else took over.⟧

items.original:
Workflow messages and exit prompts keep the recorded name after resume
Workflow control rooms and opened results keep the recorded workflow name
Newly saved workflow history and live updates use recorded names, with "name unavailable" for older runs that have none

title.zh-TW: 子代理忠實遵從自訂思考力度，支援父任務等待時並行處理
title.en: Subagents Faithfully Honor Custom Reasoning Effort, Supporting Concurrent Processing While Parent Waits

body.zh-TW: 調派多個子代理分頭協同作業時，每位代理的推理深度與模型指派現在都能精準維持。透過工作階段協定啟動的工作階段，現在會遵循所儲存的思考力度（reasoning effort，決定模型在回答前投入多少深度推理的參數）。子代理會嚴格遵循其代理定義中設定的思考力度與專屬模型；當定義的模型無法使用時，會發出通知並改為備援使用當前工作階段的模型。若工作流程中的子代理指名了你工作階段的模型，即使該模型在重啟後被隱藏或自模型清單中移除，子代理依然會維持運行。在父代理處於等待狀態時，子代理現在獲准同步處理待處理的結果，不再平白枯等。⟦彷彿專案主管在等待外部回覆時，被分派任務的助理無須跟著停工，能繼續整理其他已送達的數據資料。⟧
body.en:
When dispatching multiple subagents to collaborate on tasks, the reasoning depth and model assignment of each agent can now be maintained precisely. Sessions launched via the session protocol now follow the saved reasoning effort (a parameter determining how much deep reasoning the model invests before answering). Subagents strictly adhere to the reasoning effort and dedicated model specified in their agent definitions. When a defined model is unavailable, a notification is sent, and it falls back to using the current session's model instead. If a subagent in a workflow specifies your session's model, it keeps running even if that model is hidden or removed from the model catalog after a restart. While the parent agent is in a waiting state, subagents are now permitted to process pending results concurrently instead of waiting idly.

⟦Imagine a project manager waiting for an external reply, where assigned assistants need not sit idle and can keep organizing other data that has already arrived.⟧

items.original:
Sessions started through the session protocol honor saved reasoning effort
Subagents now honor the reasoning effort set in their agent definition
A Workflow subagent that named your session's model keeps running after a restart even when that model is now hidden or missing from the model list, the same as one that left the model out
Subagents use their definition's model, falling back to the session model with a notice when unavailable
Allow subagents to process pending results while the parent waits

title.zh-TW: muse serve 載入對話不再卡死其他請求，健全歷史還原與帳號指引
title.en: muse serve No Longer Blocks Other Requests While Loading Chats, Solidifying History Restoration and Account Guidance

body.zh-TW: 將 Muse 當作本機背景伺服器運行時，多個工作階段並行存取的排程機制有了顯著改善。當你透過 `muse serve` 處理龐大對話時，伺服器在首次載入歷史紀錄、恢復或分支工作階段、開啟側邊對話、列出待審批項目或讀取工具輸出時，都能持續回應其他請求，不再拖住其他對話；嘗試恢復載入中的工作階段也會依序等待，而非誤報已被佔用。它現在能直接顯示 Muse 1.4.8 仍運行中的對話紀錄，即便儲存檢視檔案遭刪除也能正常還原。若啟動時缺乏模型清單且帳號需補填付款方式、新手導覽或年齡確認，對話輪次會明確說明該做什麼，不再無端要求重新登入。
body.en: When running Muse as a local background server, the scheduling mechanism for concurrent session access has improved significantly. When handling large conversations via `muse serve`, the server continues responding to other requests while initially loading history, resuming or branching sessions, opening side chats, listing pending approval items, or reading tool outputs, without stalling other conversations. Attempts to resume a session that is currently loading will now wait in turn rather than falsely reporting that it is already occupied. It can now directly display ongoing conversation records from Muse 1.4.8 and cleanly restore them even if saved view files were deleted. If the model list is missing at startup and the account requires adding a payment method, completing onboarding, or confirming age, the turn explicitly explains what needs to be done instead of prompting for a re-login without explanation.

items.original:
`muse serve` now shows the history of a session that Muse 1.4.8 is still running, instead of failing to read it until that session closes
When a `muse serve` client resumes a chat whose saved history view file was deleted, the chat shows its history again instead of none
`muse serve` keeps answering other requests while a long session's history loads for the first time, and resuming a session that is still loading waits for it instead of reporting the session as in use
`muse serve` keeps answering other requests while it resumes or forks a long session, opens a side chat on one, lists its pending approvals or reads one of its tool outputs, instead of stalling every other thread until that session's history is read
When `muse serve` starts with no saved model list and your account still needs a payment method, onboarding or age confirmation, turns now say what to do instead of asking you to log in again

title.zh-TW: 手動壓縮支援外接工具，修正檢查點儲存並加速大型工作階段分支
title.en: Manual Compaction Supports External Tools, Fixing Checkpoint Saves and Accelerating Large Session Branching

body.zh-TW: 對話內容過長而需要精簡上下文時，手動輸入 `/compact` 的觸發條件與儲存機制現在更為可靠。設定了外接工具 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）的工作階段，現在可以直接執行手動 `/compact`，不再回報無可壓縮內容。在儲存檢查點時若恰好遇到其他寫入操作，不會再遺漏儲存；重新開啟已儲存的對話後，壓縮也能持續正常運作，不再重複摘要並最終報錯。如果在送出模型請求前就取消訊息，執行壓縮會如實回報沒有內容可摘要，避免留下錯誤檢查點而導致後續跳過開發者指令。當工具結果被清除或提醒過期時，`/compact` 的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）計算已獲修正；在經歷壓縮的超大型工作階段中，執行 `/btw`、`/side` 與 `/fork` 的開啟速度也明顯加快。
body.en: When conversations grow too long and context needs trimming, the trigger conditions and saving mechanisms for manually running `/compact` are now much more reliable. Sessions configured with external MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol enabling AI to connect to external tools) tools can now directly run manual `/compact` without reporting that there is nothing to compact. Saving a checkpoint while another write operation is occurring no longer drops the save. After reopening a saved conversation, compaction continues working normally rather than repeatedly summarizing and ultimately erroring out. If a message is canceled before sending the model request, running compaction accurately reports that there is no content to summarize, preventing invalid checkpoints that could cause subsequent developer instructions to be skipped. The token (a text unit for AI processing and billing) calculation for `/compact` has been corrected when tool results are cleared or reminders expire. In very large compacted sessions, opening speeds for running `/btw`, `/side`, and `/fork` are also noticeably faster.

items.original:
Manual `/compact` now compacts sessions with MCP servers configured, instead of answering "no compactable run is available"
