A context compaction no longer skips its checkpoint when another session write lands while that checkpoint is being saved
Running /compact in a chat whose turns all ended before any model request (for example, a message cancelled before Muse began preparing its model request) now reports that there is nothing to summarize instead of writing a summary checkpoint that could later let the chat skip setting up its developer instructions
Compaction keeps working after you reopen a saved chat, instead of summarizing again at every boundary and eventually failing with "could not prepare the conversation"
Correct `/compact` token counts when tool results are cleared or reminders expire
`/btw`, `/side`, and `/fork` open faster in very large compacted sessions

title.zh-TW: 工作階段恢復嚴格檢驗啟動紀錄，掛鉤只在紀錄完整時觸發執行
title.en: Session Resumption Strictly Verifies Startup Logs, Firing Hooks Only When Logs Are Fully Intact

body.zh-TW: 重新開啟先前儲存的對話時，若背後的執行紀錄曾發生缺損，盲目載入往往會引發非預期的錯誤。如果工作階段的日誌無法證實其最後一次啟動紀錄，現在會直接拒絕恢復該對話，並在訊息中點名損毀的紀錄，不再默默開啟。在終端機介面恢復工作階段時，只有日誌能證實啟動完整的對話才會觸發 SessionStart 掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），其來源會標註為 `resume`。若對象是從未啟動的分支副本，來源則標註為 `fork`。若是無法證實啟動的副本，則完全不執行掛鉤並在啟動通知中說明。已儲存的工作階段格式也新增了標記欄位，可記錄儲存當下是否仍在啟動中；雖然目前尚未正式寫入，但未來一旦開始記錄，舊版 Muse 將拒絕開啟這類工作階段以防出錯。
body.en: When reopening a previously saved conversation, blindly loading it often causes unexpected errors if the underlying execution logs were corrupted. If a session log cannot verify its last startup record, it now explicitly refuses to resume that conversation and names the corrupted record in the message, rather than opening silently. When resuming a session in the terminal interface, only conversations whose startup can be verified by the log will trigger the SessionStart hook (a small program triggered by a specific event), with its source marked as `resume`. For branched copies that have never been started, the source is marked as `fork`. For copies whose startup cannot be verified, the hook is not executed at all, and an explanation is provided in the startup notification. The saved session format also adds a flag field to record whether it was still starting up at the time of saving. Although not actively written yet, once recorded in the future, legacy versions of Muse will refuse to open such sessions to prevent errors.

items.original:
Saved sessions can record whether a run was still starting when they were saved; nothing records it yet, so no session opens differently today, and once a later Muse records it, Muse versions released before that one will not open such a session
Resuming a session whose log cannot prove its last start is refused with a message naming the broken record instead of opening silently
SessionStart hooks run on every resumed TUI session whose log proves its last start, reporting `resume` (or `fork` for a never-activated clone) as their source; a replayed copy that cannot prove it runs none and says so in its startup notice

title.zh-TW: 跨桌面與終端切換即時同步對話，分支重試具備冪等性不再撞號
title.en: Real-time conversation sync across desktop and terminal switches, with idempotent branch retries that prevent collisions

body.zh-TW: 在桌面應用程式與終端機之間切換工作環境時，不同版本之間的對話紀錄接軌現在省去了不必要的等待。若桌面端與終端機運行的 Muse Code 版本不同，切換時會直接同步另一端剛進行的簡短對話，不再從頭重新建構歷史紀錄（自 1.4.9 以前版本升級後的首次開啟仍會重建一次）。恢復進度落後的對話時，會在同一次恢復中直接補齊最新紀錄，不再出現歷史空白或遺漏即時回覆。使用相同指令識別碼重試分支時，會符合冪等（idempotent，多次執行結果與單次相同）原則直接回傳原始結果，不再報錯；指定不同切分時則維持衝突。即使對話含有中途送達的背景任務通知，分支在應用程式與 SDK 也能順利載入。工作階段中模型重複使用工具識別碼不再破壞後續壓縮，載入重複核准紀錄的工作階段時記憶體消耗也明顯降低。
body.en: When switching work environments between the desktop application and the terminal, bridging conversation history across different versions now eliminates unnecessary waiting. If the desktop app and terminal run different versions of Muse Code, switching will directly sync recent short conversations from the other side rather than rebuilding history from scratch (the first launch after upgrading from versions prior to 1.4.9 still rebuilds once). When restoring a conversation that has fallen behind, the latest records are backfilled in the same restoration pass, preventing history gaps or missing real-time replies. When retrying a branch using the same command identifier, it adheres to idempotent principles (yielding identical results when run multiple times as when run once) and directly returns the original result instead of throwing an error. Specifying a different split continues to raise a conflict. Even if a conversation contains background task notifications delivered midway, branches load smoothly across both the application and the SDK. A model reusing tool identifiers within a session no longer breaks subsequent compaction, and memory consumption drops significantly when loading sessions with duplicate approval records.

items.original:
A forked chat whose history has a background-task notice delivered mid-turn now opens in apps and SDKs in more cases, instead of failing to load
Switching a conversation between the desktop app and the terminal when they run different versions of Muse Code now catches up a short exchange made on the other side instead of rebuilding its saved history from scratch; the first open after updating from a release before 1.4.9 still rebuilds it once
Resuming a thread whose saved history had fallen far behind now brings it up to date in that same resume, instead of showing no history and missing live replies until the next resume
A session whose model reused a tool call id for two same-length results no longer becomes impossible to resume or compact after old tool results are cleared
Retrying a fork with the same command id now returns the original outcome instead of answering command_id_conflict, matching gate-off idempotency; reusing a command id with a different cut still conflicts
Reduce memory use when loading sessions with repeated approval records

title.zh-TW: 長篇分析回答改用短句分段，隱藏無回應標記並自動補問
title.en: Long analytical responses switch to short-sentence paragraphs, hiding no-reply markers with automatic follow-up questions

body.zh-TW: 閱讀 AI 產生的長篇分析報告時，密密麻麻的一整片文字往往讓人難以快速抓住重點。現在遇到長篇分析類型的回答，模型會主動採用短句與精簡段落進行排版，取代過去整面難以閱讀的文字牆。若先前對話中途意外中斷，使得某一輪的最終結果只剩下一行「前一輪未產生助手回覆」的內部標記，Muse 會自動發起一次有限度的重新提問，為你取得真正的實質回覆，並在執行摘要中主動剔除該標記。對話紀錄面板也不再顯示帶有菱形符號的「◆ [Previous turn ended without an assistant reply.]」提示列；如果回答只包含該標記，畫面不會渲染任何內容，若標記後方附有正常回答，則只乾淨呈現正式的回答內容。⟦恰似專業編輯重新編排文稿，不僅將密集論述切成清晰段落，也在印製時主動抽除排版留下的空白除錯標記。⟧
body.en: When reading long analytical reports generated by AI, dense walls of text often make it hard to quickly grasp key points. When encountering long analytical responses, the model now proactively formats output using short sentences and concise paragraphs, replacing the previously unreadable walls of text. If a previous conversation was interrupted unexpectedly so that a turn's final output was left with only an internal marker indicating that the prior turn produced no assistant reply, Muse automatically issues a bounded re-prompt to retrieve a genuine response, actively stripping that marker from the run summaries. The conversation history panel also no longer displays the prompt bar `◆ [Previous turn ended without an assistant reply.]` with its diamond symbol. If a response contains only that marker, the screen renders nothing, and if normal answers follow the marker, it cleanly presents only the formal response content. ⟦A professional editor reformats a manuscript by breaking dense arguments into clear paragraphs and stripping out leftover blank debugging marks before printing.⟧

items.original:
Long analysis answers use short sentences and paragraphs instead of dense walls of text
A turn whose final answer consists only of the "[Previous turn ended without an assistant reply.]" marker now gets one bounded re-prompt for a real reply, and the marker is stripped from run summaries
The transcript no longer shows a "◆ [Previous turn ended without an assistant reply.]" row — a reply containing only that resume marker renders nothing, and a real answer prefixed by it shows just the answer

title.zh-TW: 開發者指令阻擋改以白話引導，SDK 撤回狀態與技能範例修復
title.en: Developer command blocks switch to plain-language guidance, and SDK retraction states and skill examples receive fixes

body.zh-TW: 串接工具時，晦澀報錯常令人卡關。EdenFS 查全庫 Sapling（`hg files`、`hg locate`、`hg manifest`）卡死前阻擋，改指引 `search` 或 `hg biggrep`。衍生子行程遭拒改以白話說明，不再顯示內部列舉代碼。連接外部工具的 MCP 伺服器啟動存活未回，改報 `the server did not respond during startup` 而非泛用逾時。TypeScript 與 Python SDK 撤回遭拒不再誤標撤回或丟棄；前者的 `StaleDroppableMethod` 納入 `turn/retracted`，窮舉比對需補分支。內建 Three.js 技能改用可運作的 WebGPU 後製，不再引用已移除舊檔。
body.en: When integrating tools, cryptic error messages often cause roadblocks. Sapling repository-wide queries on EdenFS (`hg files`, `hg locate`, `hg manifest`) are blocked before hanging, redirecting users to `search` or `hg biggrep`. Spawned subprocess rejections are now explained in plain language instead of displaying internal enum codes. When an MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) server fails to respond during startup liveness checks, it now reports `the server did not respond during startup` instead of a generic timeout. Retraction rejections in the TypeScript and Python SDKs are no longer mistakenly marked as retracted or dropped. The former's `StaleDroppableMethod` now incorporates `turn/retracted`, requiring an additional branch for exhaustive matching. The built-in Three.js skill now switches to working WebGPU post-processing instead of referencing removed legacy files.

items.original:
Spawn rejection hints now explain the reason in plain words instead of internal enum names
Repository-wide Sapling file listings (`hg files`, `hg locate`, `hg manifest`) on EdenFS checkouts are refused before they hang, pointing at `search` or `hg biggrep` instead
An MCP server whose process stays alive but never responds during startup now fails with `the server did not respond during startup` instead of the generic operation timeout
The TypeScript and Python SDKs no longer mark a turn retracted, or drop its completion, when its retract is declined; in the TypeScript SDK, `StaleDroppableMethod` gains `turn/retracted`, so code that matches it exhaustively needs a new case
The bundled Three.js skill now gives a working WebGPU post-processing example instead of one that imports a file current three.js no longer ships

title.zh-TW: Muse 額度用完即使未給數字，卡片也會標示 5 小時已用滿
title.en: Cards mark the 5-hour quota as full even when Muse provides no numbers upon exhaustion

body.zh-TW: 當你連續使用 Muse 處理工作時，一旦額度耗盡，往往會想確認何時才能繼續。以往 5 小時額度一用完，Muse 通常會直接拒絕額度查詢，只拋出「Subscription quota exhausted」錯誤訊息並告知重置時間，導致卡片拿不到具體數字。⟦跟運動場地的租借機一樣，以前名額一被搶光，票機只印出額滿通知與下一場時間，看板卻因抓不到剩餘數值而沒能更新；現在螢幕會直接標示目前時段已全滿，並貼上下次開放進場的時刻。⟧現在卡片遇到這種狀況，會主動把 5 小時額度顯示為 100%，並附上該重置時間。因為這項錯誤回報裡沒有週額度數字，所以卡片上的週額度百分比會沿用上次的讀數，卡片也保留「上次查詢」的時間提示，讓你在等待額度恢復時依然能掌握先前的用量狀態。
body.en: When you use Muse continuously for work, you often want to confirm when you can resume once your quota runs out. Previously, as soon as the 5-hour quota was exhausted, Muse would typically reject quota queries outright, only throwing a "Subscription quota exhausted" error message alongside the reset time, leaving the card without concrete numbers. ⟦Much like a sports venue reservation kiosk, where the ticket machine previously printed only a full notice and the next session time once slots filled up, leaving the display unupdated because it could not fetch the remaining count, the screen now directly marks the current slot as completely full and displays the time for the next admission.⟧ Now when encountering this situation, the card proactively displays the 5-hour quota at 100% and attaches that reset time. Because this error response contains no weekly quota figures, the weekly quota percentage on the card retains its previous reading, and the card also preserves the "Last checked" timestamp prompt, allowing you to keep track of prior usage status while waiting for the quota to recover.

items.original: **The Muse card shows a used-up 5-hour window even when Muse sends no numbers.** Once the window runs out, Muse usually refuses the quota check with a "Subscription quota exhausted" error that only says when the window resets. The card now shows the window as 100% with that reset time. The error has no weekly figure, so the weekly percentage stays from the last reading and the card keeps its "last checked" badge.

title.zh-TW: Muse 的 5 小時額度用完後持續更新，用量卡片顯示已用滿
title.en: Muse continues updating after 5-hour quota is exhausted, with usage card showing full

body.zh-TW: 平時頻繁使用 Muse 協作時，如果額度見底，你可能會打開 `usage` 查看剩餘狀況與重置時間。⟦跟看停車場入口的剩餘車位看板一樣，以前場內車輛停滿甚至超額借停時，計數器因為讀到破表數字而停止刷新，螢幕凍結在用滿前一刻並掛著過期提示；現在就算車位全滿，看板也會持續更新並清楚顯示客滿。⟧Muse 在 5 小時額度耗盡時，回報的使用率常會超過 100%（例如 104%）。以前 `usage` 會直接把這種大於 100% 的讀數丟掉。這導致卡片一直停留在低於 100% 的最後一次讀數，並掛著過期標籤（stale-age badge，標示資料多久未更新的標籤），直到 5 小時週期重置。現在卡片在 5 小時額度用完後仍會持續刷新，並清楚標示為已用滿，方便你隨時掌握最新狀態。
body.en: When frequently collaborating with Muse, if your quota runs low, you might open `usage` to check the remaining status and reset time. ⟦Think of the vacancy board at a parking lot entrance. Previously, when the lot was full or even overfilled with parked cars, the counter stopped updating because it read an off-the-charts number, freezing the screen right before full capacity with an expired notice. Now, even when all spaces are full, the board continues to update and clearly displays that the lot is full.⟧ Muse exhausts its 5-hour quota, the reported usage often exceeds 100% (such as 104%). Previously, `usage` would directly discard readings greater than 100%. This caused the card to remain stuck at the last reading below 100% with a stale-age badge (a label indicating how long data has not been updated) until the 5-hour cycle reset. Now, the card continues to refresh after the 5-hour quota is exhausted and clearly indicates that it is full, making it easy for you to track the latest status at any time.

items.original: **The Muse card stays current after a 5-hour window runs out.** Muse reports an exhausted window as more than 100% used (for example 104%), and `usage` threw those readings away. The card kept the last reading under 100% with a stale-age badge until the window reset; it now shows the window as full.

title.zh-TW: Windows 鎖定螢幕時，工作列標籤暫停掃描
title.en: On Windows, the taskbar label stops scanning while the screen is locked

body.zh-TW: 有 Windows 使用者回報，電腦鎖定期間 `usage` 曾莫名當掉，原因還沒查清楚（refs #202）。工作列上的額度標籤每 2 秒會透過 UI Automation 掃描一次工作列按鈕，好決定自己擺哪裡，這個掃描是頭號嫌疑。現在螢幕鎖定時就不掃，解鎖後一切照舊。⟦像社區警衛晚上關店後就不再每兩分鐘巡一次空蕩蕩的商店街，以前整夜照巡、偶爾自己絆倒，現在鎖門就休息。⟧官方說得很清楚：這是降低風險的措施，不是確認的修復，如果之後還有當機，請繼續回報。
body.en: Some Windows users reported `usage` crashing for no clear reason while the computer was locked, and the cause is still unknown (refs #202). The quota label on the taskbar scans the taskbar buttons every 2 seconds through UI Automation to decide where to sit, and that scan is the main suspect. It now stops scanning while the screen is locked, and nothing changes while the screen is in use. ⟦A night guard used to patrol the empty shopping street every two minutes all night and occasionally trip; now the patrol pauses once the shutters are down.⟧ The changelog is explicit that this is a mitigation, not a confirmed fix, so keep reporting any further crashes.

items.original: **Windows: the taskbar label stops scanning taskbar buttons while the screen is locked.** The scan runs every 2 seconds through UI Automation and is the main suspect in an unexplained crash that happened while Windows was locked (refs #202). Nothing changes while unlocked. This is a mitigation, not a confirmed fix.

title.zh-TW: 自動啟動 5 小時計時的背景訊息變輕，也不再塞滿接續清單
title.en: Auto-start 5-hour Session sends a lighter ping and stops cluttering your resume list

body.zh-TW: 想接續昨天的對話，打開 `claude --resume` 或 `codex resume` 卻看到一整排只寫著「ok」的紀錄，要翻半天才找到真正的那筆。那些都是「自動啟動 5 小時計時」在背景送出的小訊息留下的，而且每則還會載入約 2 萬 input token（AI 計算用量的單位）。⟦像每天只是去郵局蓋個戳，以前卻得扛整箱文件排隊，還在登記簿留一筆；現在空手去、蓋完就走。⟧現在 Claude 那則不再載入工具和 MCP 伺服器，也不存成工作階段；Codex 那則改用 `--ephemeral` 執行，同樣不留紀錄。
body.en: You want to pick up yesterday's conversation, open `claude --resume` or `codex resume`, and find a long row of entries that just say "ok" before the real one. Those came from the small background pings sent by Auto-start 5-hour Session, and each ping also loaded about 20k input tokens (the unit AI usage is measured in). ⟦It was like going to the post office just for a stamp while hauling a whole box of documents and signing the logbook each time; now you go empty-handed and leave once it is stamped.⟧ The Claude ping now loads no tools or MCP servers and is not saved as a session, and the Codex ping runs with `--ephemeral`, leaving no record either.

items.original: **Auto-start 5-hour Session sends a lighter ping and no longer clutters your resume list.** The Claude ping now loads no tools or MCP servers and is not saved as a session; the Codex ping runs with `--ephemeral`. Each ping used to load about 20k input tokens and leave an "ok" conversation in `claude --resume` and `codex resume`.

title.zh-TW: 修復四處安全漏洞，防範非預期檔案寫入與驗證被繞過
title.en: Fix Four Security Vulnerabilities to Prevent Unexpected File Writes and Verification Bypasses

body.zh-TW: 下載、安裝技能或驗證產物時不再受惡意名稱所害，建議盡快升到 `v2.102.0`。`gh release download`、`gh run download`、`gh repo read-file --output` 與 `gh attestation download` 遇目的地含符號連結（指向其他位置的捷徑檔）時，以前可能寫入非預期的本機檔案。`gh attestation verify` 以前比對 `--source-ref` 不分大小寫，且 `--signer-workflow` 只比憑證身分開頭，僅大小寫不同的分支，或同儲存庫內路徑開頭相同的另一個工作流程，都可能通過驗證。互動式 `gh skill search` 傳路徑給 `gh skill install` 時缺少選項分隔符號，搜尋結果可能注入安裝選項並改寫檔案位置。⟦就像同一棟樓四扇門的鎖被一次補好。⟧
body.en: Downloading artifacts, installing skills, or verifying attestations is no longer vulnerable to malicious names, and upgrading to `v2.102.0` as soon as possible is recommended. When the destination contains a symlink, `gh release download`, `gh run download`, `gh repo read-file --output`, and `gh attestation download` previously risked writing to unintended local files. `gh attestation verify` previously compared `--source-ref` case-insensitively and only matched the prefix of certificate identities for `--signer-workflow`, allowing branches differing only by case or another workflow with a matching path prefix in the same repository to pass verification. Interactive `gh skill search` lacked an option delimiter when passing paths to `gh skill install`, which allowed search results to inject installation options and alter file locations. ⟦Picture locks on four doors of the same building being fixed all at once.⟧

items.original:
## Security

Four security vulnerabilities have been identified, and fixed, in this release. Users are advised to update gh to version `v2.102.0` as soon as possible.

`gh release download`, `gh run download`, `gh repo read-file --output`, and `gh attestation download` could write remote content to an unintended local file when the destination contained symbolic links.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-39wj-f2f4-978v for more information.

`gh attestation verify` compared the `--source-ref` value case-insensitively, so an attestation built from a branch whose name differs only in case could satisfy a policy that named a different branch.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-4mq3-hpgx-9cx8 for more information.

Interactive `gh skill search` passed repository paths from search results to `gh skill install` without an option separator, so a search result could inject installer options and change where skill files were written.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-qcwj-mr2r-2cx7 for more information.

`gh attestation verify` matched the `--signer-workflow` value against only the start of the signing certificate's identity, so an attestation signed by a different workflow in the pinned repository could pass verification when its path began with the pinned value.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-wjmr-j3rp-mh2g for more information.

title.zh-TW: Linux 上用 APT 或 RPM 裝的 gh 要認新金鑰
title.en: gh installed via APT or RPM on Linux needs the new signing key

body.zh-TW: 你在 Linux 上更新 `gh`，卻突然裝不起來、報簽章驗證失敗？多半是金鑰換了。GitHub CLI 的 APT 與 RPM 套件庫（Linux 下載與更新軟體的官方來源），連同個別的 RPM 套件檔，現在只用新的 PGP 金鑰簽署，指紋是 `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`。如果你在 2026 年 4 月 8 日前從官方 APT 或 RPM 套件庫裝了 `gh`，又還沒更新金鑰圈（電腦裡記著哪些簽章可以信任的清單），安裝或更新就可能失敗。⟦就像快遞改用新封條，你家警衛只認得舊封條，包裹就會被擋在門外，得先把新封條的樣子告訴警衛。⟧照官方的 PGP 簽章金鑰輪換說明檢查、更新金鑰圈就能解決。用 Windows、macOS，或透過 Homebrew、GitHub Releases、其他套件管理器、原始碼安裝的人不受影響。
body.en: Updating `gh` on Linux and suddenly getting a signature verification failure? The signing key most likely changed. GitHub CLI's APT and RPM repositories, along with individual RPM packages, are now signed only with the new PGP key, fingerprint `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`. If you installed `gh` from the official APT or RPM repositories before April 8, 2026 and haven't refreshed your keyring, installs and updates may fail. ⟦It's like a courier switching to a new seal: your building's guard only knows the old one, so packages get turned away until you show the guard what the new seal looks like.⟧ Follow the official PGP signing key rotation guidance to check and update your keyring. Users on Windows or macOS, and anyone who installed through Homebrew, GitHub Releases, another package manager, or from source, are not affected.

items.original:
## Linux package repository signing key rotation

GitHub CLI's APT and RPM repositories, along with individual RPM packages, are now signed only with the new PGP key (fingerprint: `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Linux users who installed `gh` from the official APT or RPM repositories before April 8, 2026, and have not refreshed their keyring, may now see package installation or update failures. Follow the [PGP signing key rotation guidance](https://github.com/cli/cli/issues/13118) to check and update your keyring. Users on Windows or macOS, and users who installed `gh` through Homebrew, GitHub Releases, another package manager, or from source, are not affected.

title.zh-TW: gh 登入時自動幫你複製驗證碼
title.en: gh now copies your login code for you

body.zh-TW:
用 `gh auth login` 登入 GitHub，或用 `gh auth refresh` 更新權限時，畫面會給你一組 OAuth 裝置代碼（要貼到瀏覽器授權頁、證明是你本人在登入的短碼）。以前你得自己反白、複製，再切到瀏覽器貼上；現在這兩個指令預設會直接把代碼放進剪貼簿，切過去按貼上就好。⟦櫃檯人員直接把號碼牌塞到你手上，你就不必再拿筆抄一次號碼。⟧不想要這個行為，可以用下面這行永久關掉：

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

某一次執行時如果你另外指定了剪貼簿選項，那一次就照你指定的來。
body.en:
When you sign in with `gh auth login` or refresh permissions with `gh auth refresh`, the screen gives you an OAuth device code to paste into the browser's authorization page. You used to highlight it, copy it, then switch to the browser and paste. Now both commands put the code on your clipboard by default, so you just switch over and paste. ⟦Think of a service desk where the clerk hands you the ticket instead of making you copy the number down with a pen.⟧ To turn this off for good, run:

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

If you pass an explicit clipboard option on a single run, that run follows your choice.

items.original:
## Copy authentication codes to the clipboard by default

`gh auth login` and `gh auth refresh` now copy OAuth device codes to the clipboard by default, saving a manual copy step during authentication.

To persistently opt out, run:

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

Explicit clipboard options still take precedence for an individual invocation.

title.zh-TW: GitHub API 流量支援自訂閘道，身分驗證與網址維持直連
title.en: GitHub API Traffic Supports Custom Gateways, While Authentication and URLs Remain Direct

body.zh-TW:
企業若需要稽核或集中管控網路流量，現在可以透過個別主機的 `api_host` 設定，將 GitHub API 請求導向自訂閘道（gateway，把流量轉去另一個位址再送出的中繼點）。這項改動只會轉發 API 呼叫，登入身分驗證、Git 遠端儲存庫操作與瀏覽器開啟網址仍會直接連線至原始主機。此功能目前仍處於實驗階段，且不是安全邊界，部分請求可能依然會送往原始主機。

```
# 設定將 github.com 的 API 流量轉發至自訂閘道
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# 查詢特定主機目前設定的 API 閘道位址
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

⟦這就像公司設立的公務收發室，員工採購與查詢資料等業務公文統一由專屬窗口轉交處理，但員工出勤打卡、私人包裹寄送與親自拜訪仍直接走大樓正門。⟧
body.en:
Organizations that need to audit or centrally manage network traffic can now route GitHub API requests to a custom gateway via the per-host `api_host` setting. This change only forwards API calls; login authentication, Git remote repository operations, and browser-opened URLs still connect directly to the original host. This feature is currently experimental and is not a security boundary, so some requests may still reach the original host.

```
# Set up forwarding API traffic for github.com to a custom gateway
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# Query the currently configured API gateway address for a specific host
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

⟦This is like a company mailroom for official business, where business documents such as procurement requests and data inquiries are routed through a dedicated counter, while employee clock-ins, personal parcel deliveries, and in-person visits still go directly through the building's main entrance.⟧

items.original:
## Experimental: Route GitHub API traffic through a custom host

Organizations can now route a GitHub host's API traffic through a gateway using the new per-host `api_host` configuration:

```shell
# Route API traffic for github.com through a gateway
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# Read the configured API host
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

The original host remains in use for authentication, Git remotes, and browser URLs.

> [!NOTE]
> `api_host` is experimental and is not a security boundary. Requests may still reach the original host.
